Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Kol makom sheyyesh bo asara miyyisrael tzarich lehachin lo bayit sheyyikkansu bo litfilla bechol et tefilla umakom ze nikra bet hakkeneset. vechofin bene hair ze et ze livnot lahem bet hakkeneset veliknot lahem sefer tora neviim uchetuvim:

Keshebbonin bet hakkeneset en bonin otah ella begavhah shel ir shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 1 21)</small> "berosh homiyyot tikra". umagbihin otah ad shettehe gevoha mikkol chatzrot hair shenneemar <small>(Ezra 9 9)</small> "uleromem et bet elohenu". veen potchin pitche bet hakkeneset ella bammizrach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 38)</small> "vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma". uvonin bo hechol shemmannichin bo sefer tora. uvonin hechol ze baruach shemmitpallelin kenegdo beotah hair. kede sheyyihyu penehem el mul hahechol kesheyyaamdu litfilla:

Umaamidin bima beemtza habbayit kede sheyyaale aleha hakkore battora o mi asher omer laam divre kibbushin kede sheyyishmeu kullam. ucheshemmaamidin hatteva sheyyesh bah sefer tora maamidin otah baemtza vaachore hatteva kelappe hahechol ufaneha kelappe haam:

Ketzad haam yoshvin bevatte kenesiyyot. hazzekenim yoshvin ufenehen kelappe haam vaachorehem kelappe hahechol. vechol haam yoshvin shura lifne shura ufene hashshura laachore hashshura shellefaneha ad sheyyihyu pene kol haam kelappe hakkodesh uchelappe hazzekenim uchelappe hatteva. uveet sheshsheliach tzibbur omed litfilla omed baaretz lifne hatteva ufanav lifne hakkodesh kishar haam:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot nohagin bahen kavod umechabbedim otan umarbitzin otan. venohagin kol yisrael bisfarad uvammaarav beshinar uveeretz hatztzevi lehadelik ashashiyyot bevatte kenesiyyot ulehatztzia bekarkaan machtzelaot kede leshev alehem. uveare edom yoshvin bah al hakkisot:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot en nohagin bahen kallut rosh kegon sechok vehittul vesicha betela. veen ochlin bahen veen shotin bahen veen neotin bahen veen metayyelin bahen veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vachachamim vetalmidehem muttarin leechol velishtot bahen middochak:

Veen mechashshevin bahen cheshbonot ella im ken hayu cheshbonot shel mitzva kegon kuppa shel tzedaka ufidyon shevuyim vechayyotze bahen. veen maspidin bahen ella hesped shel rabbim kegon sheyyihye sham hesped gedole chachme otah hair shekkol haam mitkabbetzin uvain biglalan:

Haya levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash shene petachin lo yaasennu kappandarya kede sheyyikkanes befetach ze veyetze bappetach shekkenegdo lekarev hadderech. sheasur likkanes bahen ella lidvar mitzva:

Mi shetztzarich likkanes levet hakkeneset likrot tinok o chavero yikkanes veyikra meat o yomar shemua veachar kach yikra chavero kede shello yikkanes bishvil chafatzav bilvad. veim eno yodea yomar letinok min hattinokot kera li happasuk sheatta kore bo. o yishhe meat bevet hakkeneset veachar kach yetze. shehayeshiva sham meiske hammitzvot hi shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 84 5)</small> "ashre yoshve vetecha" vegomer:

Mi shennichnas lehitpallel o likrot muttar lo latzet bappetach shekkenegdo kede lekarev et hadderech. umuttar laadam likkanes levet hakkeneset bemaklo beminalo uvaafundato uvaavak sheal raglav. veim haya tzarich larok yarok bevet hakkeneset:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shecharvu bikdushshatan hen omdot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 lo)</small> "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem" af al pi shehen shommin bikdushshatan hen omdin. ucheshem shennohagin bahen kavod beyishshuvan kach nohagin bahen bechurbanam chutz mikkibbud veribbutz sheen mechabbedin otan veen marbitzin otan. alu bahen asavim tolshin otam umannichin otan bimkoman kede sheyyiru otan haam veteor rucham veyivnum:

En sotrin bet hakkeneset kede livnot acher bimkomo o bemakom acher. aval bonin acher veachar kach sotrin ze. shemma yeera lahem ones velo yivnu. afillu kotel echad mimmennu bone hechadash betzad hayyashan veachar kach soter hayyashan:

Bamme devarim amurim shello charvu yesodotav o shello natu ketalav lippol. aval im charvu yesodotav o shennatu ketalav lippol sotrin oto miyyad umatchilin livnot bimhera bayyom uvallayla shemma tidchok hashshaa veyishshaer charev:

Muttar laasot bet hakkeneset bet hammidrash. aval bet hammidrash asur laasoto bet hakkeneset. shekkedushshat bet hammidrash yetera al kedushshat bet hakkeneset umaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. vechen bene hair shemmachru bet hakkeneset yesh lahen likkach bedamav teva. machru teva yesh lahen likkach bedameha mitpachot o tik lesefer tora. machru mitpachot o tik lokchim bedamav chummashim. machru chummashin lokchin bedamav sefer tora. aval im machru sefer tora en lokchin bedamav ella sefer tora acher sheen sham kedushsha lemala mikkedushshat sefer tora. vechen bemotareha:

Vechen im gavu haam maot livnot bet hammidrash o levet hakkeneset o liknot teva o mitpachot vetik o sefer tora veratzu leshannot kol ma sheggavu. en meshannin otan ella mikkedushsha kalla likdushsha chamura mimmenna. aval im asu ma sheggavu laasot vehotiru meshannin hammotar lechol ma sheyyirtzu. vechol kele bet hakkeneset kevet hakkeneset. parochet sheal haaron shemmannichim bo hassefarim kemitpechot hassefarim. veim hitnu alehem hare hen kefi hattenay:

Bamme devarim amurim shemmuttar limkor bet hakkeneset, bevet hakkeneset shel kefarim shello asu oto ella al daat bene hakkefar levaddam sheyyihye lahem lehitpallel bo sheim ratzu kullam lemachro muttarin. aval bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin hoil veal daat kol anshe haolam naasa sheyyavo veyitpallel bo kol habba el hammedina naasa shel kol yisrael veen mochrin oto leolam:

Bene hakkefar sheratzu limkor bet hakkeneset shellahen o livnot bedamav bet hakkeneset acher o liknot bedamav teva o sefer tora tzerichin lehatenot al hallokeach shello laasot oto lo merchatz velo burseki. vehu hammakom shemmeabbedin bo et haorot. velo bet hattevila velo bet hammayim. veim hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair bishat mechira sheyyehe hallokeach muttar laasot bo kol ellu muttar:

Vechen im hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair al motar haddamim sheyyihyu chullin hare hen chullin. ucheshellokchin haddamim uvonin mehen bet hakkeneset acher o sheyyiknu mehem teva o mitpachot vetik o chummashin o sefer tora hashshear yehe chullin kemo shehitnu veyaasu bahen ma sheyyirtzu:
Vechen im kibbelu alehen kol anshe hair o rubbam adam echad. kol ma sheasa asuy vehu mocher venoten levaddo kefi ma sheyyire veyatne kefi ma sheyyire:

Keshem shemmuttar lahem limkor bet hakkeneset kach notnin oto bemattana. sheillu lo haya lahem latztzibbur hanaya bemattana zo lo netanuhu. aval lo maskirin oto velo memashkenin oto. vechen keshessotrin batte kenesiyyot livnotan muttarin limkor ulehachalif velatet bemattana hallevenim vehaetzim veheafar shellahen. aval lehalevotan asur sheen hakkedushsha ola mehen ella bedamim o bahanaya shehi kedamim:

Rechovah shel ir af al pi shehaam mitpallelin bo betaaniyyot uvemaamadot mippene shehakkibbutz rav veen batte kenesiyyot mechilin otan en bo kedushsha mippene shehu aray velo nikba litfilla. vechen battim vachatzerot shehaam mitkabbetzin bahem litfilla en bahem kedushsha mippene shello kavu otam litfilla bilvad ella aray mitpallelim bahen keadam shemmitpallel betoch beto:

Moshe rabbenu tikken lahem lisrael sheyyehu korin battora barabbim beshabbat uvesheni uvachamishi beshacharit kede shello yishhu shelosha yamim belo shemiat tora. veezra tikken sheyyehu korin ken bemincha bechol shabbat mishshum yoshve keranot. vegam hu tikken sheyyehu korin besheni uvachamishi shelosha bene adam velo yikreu pachot measara pesukim:

Veellu hen hayyamim shekkorin bahem battora betzibbur. beshabbatot uvemoadim uverashe chodashim uvetaaniyyot uvachanukka uvefurim uvesheni vachamishi shebbechol shavua veshavua. veen maftirin banneviim ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim vetisha beav bilvad:

En korin battora betzibbur befachot measara anashim gedolim bene chorin. veen korin pachot measara pesukim. vaydabber ole min hamminyan. velo yihyu hakkorin pachot mishshelosha anashim. veen matchilin befarasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. veen meshayyerin befarasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. velo yikra hakkore pachot mishshelosha pesukim:
Shelosha shekkaru asara pesukim shenayim korin shelosha shelosha veechad arbaa. uven shehaya hakkore arbaa rishon o acharon o emtzai hare ze meshubbach:

Kol echad veechad min hakkorin poteach sefer tora umabbit lammakom shehu kore bo. veachar kach omer barchu et Adonai hamevorach vechol haam onin baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed [ ]. vechozer umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato baruch atta Adonai noten hattora. vechol haam onin amen. veachar kach kore ad sheyyashlim likrot vegolel hassefer umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher natan lanu torato torat emet vechayye olam nata betochenu baruch atta Adonai noten hattora:

En hakkore battora rashshay likrot battora ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. kara vetaa afillu bedikduk ot achat machzirin oto ad sheyyikraenna bedikduk. velo yikreu shenayim battora ella haechad levaddo. kara venishtattek yaamod acher tachtav veyatchil mimmakom shehitchil harishon shennishtattek umevarech bassof:

En hakkore rashshay likrot ad sheyyomar lo gadol shebbatztzibbur likrot. vaafillu chazzan hakkeneset o rosh hakkeneset eno kore meatzmo ad sheyyomru lo hatztzibbur o gadol shebbahem likrot. vetzarich echad laamod immo bishat keria kederech chazzan haomed im hakkorin:

Hakkore yesh lo ledalleg mimmakom lemakom beinyan echad kegon <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" v<small>(Vayikra 23 27)</small> "ach beasor" shebbefarashat <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "emor el hakkohanim". vehu shello yikra al pe sheasur likrot shello min hakketav afillu teva achat. velo yishhe bedillug ella kede sheyyashlim hatturgeman targum happasuk:

Kevan shehitchil hakkore likrot battora asur lesapper afillu bidvar halacha ella hakkol shomin veshotkin umesimin libbam lema shehu kore shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 8 3)</small> "veazne chol haam el sefer hattora". veasur latzet min hakkeneset beshaa shehakkore kore. umuttar latzet ben ish leish. umi shehu osek battora tamid vetorato umnuto muttar lo laasok betalmud tora beshaa shehakkore kore battora:

Mimot ezra nahagu sheyyehe sham turgeman metargem laam ma shehakkore kore battora kede sheyyavinu inyan haddevarim. vehakkore kore pasuk echad bilvad veshotek ad sheyyetargem oto hatturgeman vechozer vekore pasuk sheni. veen hakkore rashshay likrot lamturgeman yoter mippasuk echad:

En hakkore rashshay lehagebiah kolo yoter min hametargem. vehametargem lo yagbiah kolo yoter min hakkore. veen hametargem rashshay letargem ad sheyyichle happasuk mippi hakkore. veen hakkore rashshay likrot pasuk acher ad sheyyichle hattargum mippi hatturgeman. veen hatturgeman nishan lo leammud velo lekora ella omed beema uveyira. velo yetargem mittoch hakketav ella al pe. veen hakkore rashshay lesayyea latturgeman shello yomru targum katuv battora. vehakkatan metargem al yede gadol veen kavod laggadol sheyyetargem al yede katan. velo yihyu hametargemin shenayim keechad ella echad kore veechad metargem:

Velo kol hammikraot metargeminan betzibbur. <small>(Bereshit la 22)</small> "maase reuven" u<small>(Bamidbar 6 22 27)</small> "virkat kohanim" umaase haegel min <small>(Shemot 32 21)</small> "vayyomer moshe el aharon" ad <small>(Shemot 32 25)</small> "vayyar moshe et haam" vegomer veod pasuk echad <small>(Shemot 32 la)</small> "vayyiggof Adonai et haam" kullam nikrain velo mittargemin. uvemaase amnon bammakom shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 13 1)</small> "amnon ben david" nikra velo mittargem:

Hammaftir bannavi tzarich likrot battora techilla afillu shelosha pesukim. chozer vekore ma shekkara lefanav. velo yaftir bannavi ad sheyyiglol sefer tora. velo yifchot meesrim veechad pesukim. veim shalem hainyan befachot meellu eno tzarich lehosif. veim kara asara pesukim vetirgeman hametargem dayyo vaafillu lo shalem hainyan. uvannavi echad kore vaafillu shenayim metargemin. umedalleg meinyan leinyan acher. veeno medalleg minnavi lenavi ella binviim shel shenem asar bilvad. uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchillato. vechol hamedalleg lo yishhe bedillug ella kede sheyyashlim hametargem targumo:

Hakkore bannavi yesh lo likrot latturgeman shelosha pesukim vehametargem metargem shelashtan ze achar ze. veim hayu shelosha happesukim shalosh parashiyyot lo yikra latturgeman ella echad echad bilvad:

Hammaftir bannavi mevarech lefanav beracha achat. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar binviim vechulei. umevarech leacharav arba berachot. beracha rishona chotem bah hael hanneeman bechol devarav. sheniyya chotem bah bone yerushalayim. shelishit chotem bah magen david. reviit chotem bah inyan kedushshat hayyom kemo shechotem battefilla. vechen im chal rosh chodesh lihyot beshabbat hammaftir bannavi mazkir rosh chodesh bivracha zo kemo shemmazkir battefilla:

Kamma hen hakkorin. beshabbat beshacharit korin shiva. uveyom hakkippurim shishsha. uveyamim tovim chamishsha. en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehem. berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed korin arbaa. beshabbat uveyom hakkippurim bemincha uvesheni uvachamishi shel kol hashshana uvachanukka uvefurim beshacharit uvime hattaanit beshacharit uvemincha korin shelosha. en pochatin mimminyan ze veen mosifin alehen:

Ishsha lo tikra betzibbur mippene kevod hatztzibbur. katan hayyodea likrot veyodea lemi mevarchin ole mimminyan hakkorim. vechen maftir ole mehamminyan shehare hu kore battora. veim hifsik sheliach tzibbur bekaddish ben mashlim uven hammaftir eno ole min hamminyan. tzibbur shello haya bahem yodea likrot ella echad ole vekore veyored vechozer vekore sheniyya ushelishit ad sheyyigmor minyan hakkorim shel oto hayyom:

Bechol keria ukeria meellu kohen kore rishon veacharav levi veacharav miyyisrael. uminhag pashut hu hayyom sheafillu kohen am haaretz kodem likrot lifne chacham gadol yisrael. vechol mi shehu gadol mechavero bechachma kodem likrot. vehaacharon sheggolel sefer tora notel sachar keneged hakkol. lefichach ole umashlim afillu gadol shebbatztzibbur:

En sham kohen ole yisrael. velo yaale acharav levi kelal. en sham levi kohen shekkara rishon chozer vekore hu atzmo paam sheniyya bimkom levi. aval lo yikra acharav kohen acher shemma yomru harishon pasul ulefichach ole kohen acher. vechen lo yikra levi achar levi shemma yomru echad mishshenehem pasul:

Ketzad seder hakkeria battora. achar hattefilla kol yom sheyyesh bo tefillat musaf achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekore leechad echad min hatztzibbur veolin vekorin battora. uchesheggomrin machazir sefer tora limkomah veomer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat musaf. veyamim sheyyesh bahen maftir umusaf nahagu lomar kaddish kodem sheyyaale hammaftir. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lomar kaddish achar hammaftir:

Uvemincha shel shabbat veshel yom hakkippurim achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" veseder hayyom omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora veolin vekorin bo umachaziro veomer kaddish umitpallelin mincha. vechen betaanit korin bemincha veachar kach omer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat mincha. aval beyom tov lo nahagu likrot bemincha:

Veyom sheen bo musaf kesheggomer tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekorin bo umachaziro veomer kaddish veachar kach omer <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" veseder hayyom kederech sheomrim bechol yom veomer kaddish vechol haam niftarin:

En korin bechummashin bevatte kenesiyyot mishshum kevod tzibbur. veen gollin sefer tora betzibbur mippene torach hatztzibbur shello yatriach alehem lihyotan omdin ad sheyyiglol sefer tora. lefichach im yitztarchu likrot shene inyanim motziin shene sifre tora. velo yikra ish echad inyan echad bishte torot shemma yomru sefer rishon pagum haya ulefichach kore bashsheni:

Kol haggolel sefer tora gollu mibbachutz ucheshehu mehaddeko mehaddeko mibbifnim. vetzarich lehaamido al hattefer kede shello yikkara. makom shemmotziin sefer tora achar shekkorin bo umolichin oto levet acher lehatzenio en hatztzibbur rashshain latzet ad sheyyetze sefer tora vilauu oto vehem acharav ad hammakom shemmatzniin oto bo:

Hamminhag happashut bechol yisral shemmashlimin et hattora beshana achat. matchilin beshabbat sheachar chag hassukkot vekorin beseder <small>(Bereshit 1 1)</small> "bereshit". bashsheniyya <small>(Bereshit 6 9)</small> "elle toldot". bashshelishit <small>(Bereshit 12 1)</small> "vayyomer Adonai el avram". vekorin veholchin al hasseder hazze ad sheggomrin et hattora bechag hassukkot. veyesh mi shemmashlim et hattora beshalosh shanim veeno minhag pashut:

Ezra tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu korin kelalot shebbesefer vayyikra kodem atzeret veshebbemishne tora kodem rosh hashshana. vehamminhag happashut sheyyehu korin <small>(Bamidbar 1 1)</small> "bemidbar sinay" kodem atzeret. <small>(Devarim 3 23)</small> "vaetchannan" achar tisha beav. <small>(Devarim 29 9)</small> "attem nitztzavim" kodem rosh hashshana. <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "tzav et aharon" kodem happesach beshana peshuta. lefichach yesh shabbatot shekkorin shacharit shene sedarin kegon <small>(Vayikra 12 2)</small> "ishsha ki tazria" v<small>(Vayikra 14 2)</small> "zot tihye torat hammetzora". <small>(Vayikra 26 3)</small> "im bechukkotay" im <small>(Vayikra 25 1)</small> "behar sinay" vechayyotze bahen kede sheyyashlimu beshana veyikreu otan hassedarim beonatan:

Makom shemmafsikin beshabbat beshacharit sham korin bemincha uvesheni uvachamishi uleshabbat habbaa. ketzad. shabbat rishona korin beshacharit beseder <small>(Bereshit 1 1)</small> "bereshit". bemincha korin <small>(Bereshit 6 9)</small> "elle toldot noach" asara pesukim o yoter. vechen besheni uvachamishi. vechen leshabbat habbaa beshacharit matchilin meelle toldot noach vekore ad sof hasseder. veal derech zo korin kol hashshana. umaftirin bechol shabbat veshabbat bannavi meen shekkara battora:

Uverashe chodashim. harishon kore shelosha pesukim mipparashat <small>(Bamidbar 28 2)</small> "tzav". vehashsheni chozer vekore pasuk 3 shekkara harishon ushene pesukim sheacharav kede sheyyeshayyer bapparasha shelosha pesukim. vehashshelishi kore shelosha pesukim sheshshiyyer hashsheni im <small>(Bamidbar 28 9)</small> "uveyom hashshabbat". veharvii kore <small>(Bamidbar 28 11)</small> "uverashe chadshechem". veim chal rosh chodesh lihyot beshabbat motziin shene sefarim beshacharit. beechad korin bo seder otah shabbat uvashsheni kore bo hammashlim uverashe chadshechem. vehammaftir kore inyan rosh chodesh. umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 66 23)</small> "vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho". verosh chodesh av shechal lihyot beshabbat maftirin <small>(yeshaya 1 14)</small> "chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi". verosh chodesh shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat maftirin bashshabbat shellefanav <small>(Shmuel 1 20 18)</small> "vayyomer lo yehonatan machar chodesh":

Kol haole likrot battora poteach bedavar tov umesayyem bedavar tov. aval parashat <small>(Devarim 32 1)</small> "haazinu" kore harishon ad <small>(Devarim 32 7)</small> "zechor yemot olam". vehashsheni matchil mizzechor yemot olam ad <small>(Devarim 32 13)</small> "yarkivehu". vehashshelishi miyyarkivehu ad vayyar Adonai vayyinatz. veharvii min vayyar Adonai vayyinatz ad <small>(Devarim 32 29)</small> "lu chachmu". vehachamishi min lu chachmu ad <small>(Devarim 32 40)</small> "ki essa el shamayim yadi". vehashshishshi mikki essa el shamayim yadi ad sof hashshira. velamma poskin bah beinyanot ellu mippene shehen tochacha kede sheyyachzeru haam bitshuva:

Shemona pesukim shebbesof hattora muttar likrot otam bevet hakkeneset befachot measara. af al pi shehakkol tora hi umoshe mippi haggevura amaram hoil umashmaan shehem achar mitat moshe hare nishtannu ulefichach muttar leyachid likrot otan:

Kelalot shebbetorat kohanim en mafsikin bahen ella echad kore otan matchil bappasuk shellifnehem umesayyem bappasuk shel acharehem. ukelalot shebbemishne tora im ratza lifsok bahen posek uchevar nahagu haam shello lifsok bahen ella echad kore otan:

Mafsikin lemoadot uleyom hakkippurim vekorin beinyan hammoed, lo beseder shabbat. umoshe tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu korin bechol moed inyano. veshoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom bechol moed umoed. uma hen korin. befesach befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim. uchevar nahagu haam likrot beyom rishon <small>(Shemot 12 21)</small> "mishchu ukechu lachem" umaftirin b<small>(gemara Megila lo 1)</small> "fesach gilgal". uveyom tov sheni <small>(Vayikra 22 27)</small> "shor o chesev" umaftirin befesach yoshiyyahu. bashshelishi <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "kaddesh li chol bechor". barvii <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "im kesef talve". bachamishi <small>(Shemot 34 1)</small> "pesal lecha". beshishshi <small>(Bamidbar 9 2)</small> "veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado". beyom tov acharon <small>(Shemot 13 17)</small> "vayhi beshallach" ad sof hashshira ad <small>(Shemot 15 26)</small> "ki ani Adonai rofecha" umaftirin <small>(Shmuel 2 22 1)</small> "vaydabber david". uvashshemini <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor" umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 10 32)</small> "od hayyom":

Baatzeret korin b<small>(Devarim 16 9)</small> "shiva shavuot". uminhag pashut shekkorim beyom tov harishon <small>(Shemot 19 1)</small> "bachodesh hashshelishi" umaftirin bemerkava. uvesheni korin befarashat moadot <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor" umaftirin bachavakkuk:

Berosh hashshana korin <small>(Bamidbar 29 1)</small> "bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh". uminhag pashut shekkorin beyom rishon <small>(Bereshit 21 1)</small> "vaAdonai pakad et sara" umaftirin <small>(Shmuel 1 1 1)</small> "vayhi ish echad min haramatayim". uvesheni korin <small>(Bereshit 22 1)</small> "vehaelohim nissa et avraham" umaftirin <small>(yirmeya lo 19)</small> "haven yakkir li efrayim":

Beyom hakkippurim beshacharit korin <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 57 15)</small> "ko amar ram venissa". bemincha korin baarayot shebbeachare mot kede sheyyizkor veyikkalem kol mi shennichshal beachat mehen veyachazor bitshuva. vehashshelishi kore battora umaftir beyona:

Besukkot bishne yamim tovim harishonim korin befarashat hammoadot shehi <small>(Vayikra 22 27)</small> "shor o chesev o ez" vegomer umaftirin beyom rishon <small>(Zecharya 14 1)</small> "hinne yom ba laAdonai". uveyom sheni <small>(Melachim 1 8 2)</small> "vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo". uveyom tov acharon korin <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor" umaftirin <small>(Melachim 1 8 54)</small> "vayhi kechallot shelomo". ulemachar korin <small>(Devarim 33 1)</small> "vezot habberacha" umaftirin <small>(Melachim 1 8 22)</small> "vayyaamod shelomo". veyesh mi shemmaftirin <small>(Yehoshua 1 1)</small> "vayhi achare mot mshe". uvishar yemot hechag korin bekarbenot hechag:

Ketzad. bechol yom vayom mechullo shel moed kore shete parashiyyot. <small>(Bamidbar 29 20)</small> "bayyom hashshelishi" shehu chullo shel moed kore hakkohen <small>(Bamidbar 29 17)</small> "uvayyom hashsheni". velevi kore uvayyom hashshelishi. veyisrael kore bayyom hashshelishi. veharvii chozer vekore bayyom hashsheni uvayyom hashshelishi. vechen bayyom harvii shehu sheni shel chullo shel moed korin uvayyom hashshelishi <small>(Bamidbar 29 23)</small> "uvayyom harvii". veal derech zo bechol yom vayom:

Bechol yom veyom miyyamim tovim vechen beyom hakkippurim uveshivat yeme happesach motziin shene sefarim beshacharit. harishon kore bo ellu hainyanot sheamarnu. vehashsheni kore bo karban oto hayyom haamur bechummash happekuddim battora. vehakkore inyan hakkarban hu maftir bannavi:

Uvechol yom shemmotziin shene sefarim o shelosha im hotziu ze achar ze keshemmachazir et harishon omer kaddish umotzi hashsheni. ucheshemmachazir et haacharon omer kaddish. uchevar amarnu shehamminhag happashut lomar kaddish achar shekkore hammashlim leolam veachar kach maftirin bannavi:

Shabbat shechala lihyot bechullo shel moed ben befesach ben besukkot korin beotah shabbat <small>(Shemot 33 12)</small> "ree atta omer elay" umaftirin befesach <small>(Yechezkel 37 4)</small> "haatzamot hayeveshot". veim chala betoch hechag <small>(Yechezkel 38 18)</small> "beyom bo gog":

Bachanukka beyom rishon korin mi<small>(Bamidbar 6 22)</small> "birkat kohanim" ad sof karban <small>(Bamidbar 7 12)</small> "hammakriv bayyom harishon". uveyom sheni korin karban nasi shehikriv besheni. vechen ad yom hashshemini. beyom shemini korin ad sof hakkarbanot ad sof hasseder. umaftirin beshabbat shel chanukka benerot zecharya. veim hayu shete shabbatot bachanukka maftirin beshabbat rishona benerot zecharya. uvashsheniyya benerot shelomo. vehakkore beinyan chanukka hu shemmaftir bannavi. befurim korin beshacharit <small>(Shemot 17 8)</small> "vayyavo amalek":

Betisha beav korin beshacharit <small>(Devarim 4 25)</small> "ki tolid banim" umaftirin <small>(yirmeya 8 13)</small> "asof asifem neum Adonai". uvemincha korin <small>(Shemot 32 11)</small> "vaychal mshe" kishar yeme hattaaniyyot. uvishar hattaaniyyot sheanu mitanin al ma sheera laavotenu korin beshacharit umincha. harishon kore vaychal moshe arba pesukim. vekore hashsheni vehashshelishi mi<small>(Shemot 34 1)</small> "pesal lecha" ad <small>(Shemot 34 10)</small> "asher ani osho immach". uvetaaniyyot sheggozrin otan hatztzibbur mippene hatztzarot kegon batztzoret vedever vechayyotze bahen korin berachot ukelalot kede sheyyashuvu haam veyikkana levavam kesheyyishmeu otam:

Nahagu haam lihyot maftirin kodem tisha beav beshalosh shabbatot bedivre tochachot. shabbat rishona maftirin b<small>(yirmeya 1 1)</small> "divre yirmeyahu". sheniyya <small>(yeshaya 1 1)</small> "chazon yeshayahu". shelishit <small>(yeshaya 1 21)</small> "echa hayta lezona". vechen shabbat sheachar tisha beav maftirin <small>(yeshaya 40 1)</small> "nachamu nachamu ammi". uminhag pashut beirenu lihyot maftirin benechamot yeshayahu meachar tisha beav ad rosh hashshana. veshabbat shebben rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim maftirin <small>(Hoshea 14 2)</small> "shuva yisrael":

Rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat korin befarashat <small>(Shemot 30 11 16)</small> "shekalim" umaftirin bi<small>(Melachim 2 12 3)</small> "yhoyada hakkohen". vechen im chal rosh chodesh adar lihyot betoch hashshabbat vaafillu beerev shabbat makdimin vekorin bashshabbat shellefanav befarashat shekalim. bashsheniyya korin <small>(Devarim 25 17)</small> "zachor" umaftirin <small>(Shmuel 1 15 2)</small> "pakadti et asher asa amalek". e zo hi shabbat sheniyya kol shechal purim lihyot betochah vaafillu beerev shabbat. bashshelishit korin <small>(Bamidbar 19 1)</small> "para adumma" umaftirin <small>(Yechezkel 36 25)</small> "vezarakti alechem". vee zo hi shabbat shelishit hassemucha larviit. barviit korin <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze" umaftirin <small>(Yechezkel 45 18)</small> "berishon beechad lachodesh". vee zo hi reviit kol shechal rosh chodesh nisan lihyot betochah vaafillu beerev shabbat:

Nimtzeta omer sheppeamim tihye hafesaka ben shabbat rishona usheniyya o ben sheniyya ushelishit. ufeamim yihyu shete hafesakot ben rishona lishniyya uven sheniyya ushelishit. aval ben shelishit lirviit en mafsikin:

Kol parasha mearba parashiyyot haellu echad kore otah besefer sheni achar shekkorin seder otah shabbat bassefer shehotziu rishon. chal rosh chodesh adar lihyot beshabbat vehaya seder otah shabbat bi <small>(Shemot 27 20)</small> "veatta tetzavve" korin shishsha mivveatta tetzavve ad <small>(Shemot 30 18)</small> "veasita kiyyor nechshet" vehashshevii chozer vekore mikki tissa ad veasita kiyyor. veim haya seder otah shabbat ki tissa atzmo korin shishsha mikki tissa ad <small>(Shemot la 1)</small> "vayyakhel" vehashshevii chozer vekore besefer sheni mikki tissa ad veasita kiyyor nechoshet:

Rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat motziin shelosha sefarim. harishon kore bo seder hayyom. vehashsheni kore bo inyan rosh chodesh. vehashshelishi korin bo <small>(Shemot 30 12)</small> "ki tissa". vechen rosh chodesh nisan shechal lihyot beshabbat motziin shelosha sefarim. korin seder hayyom barishon. veinyan rosh chodesh bashsheni. v<small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze" bashshelishi:

Rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot beshabbat motziin shelosha sefarim. harishon kore bo seder hayyom. vehashsheni kore bo inyan rosh chodesh. vehashshelishi kore bo inyan chanukka. chal lihyot beemtza hashshabbat shelosha korin beinyan rosh chodesh veharvii kore beinyan chanukka:

Af al pi sheadam shomea kol hattora kullah bechol shabbat batztzibbur chayyav likrot leatzmo bechol shavua veshavua seder shel otah shabbat shenayim mikra veechad targum. ufasuk sheen bo targum korehu shalosh peamim ad sheyyashlim parashiyyotav im hatztzibbur:

Beshacharit bemusaf uvinilo hakkohanim nosim et kappehem. aval bemincha en nesiat kappayim. mippene shebbemincha kevar saadu kol haam veshemma shatu hakkohanim yayin veshikkor asur binsiat kappayim. vaafillu beyom taanit en nosin kappehen bemincha gezera minchat taanit mippene minchat kol yom:

Bamme devarim amurim betaaniyyot shemmitpallelin bo mincha uneila kegon tzom kippur vetaanit tzibbur. aval taanit sheen bo neila kegon tisha beav veshiva asar betammuz hoil utefillat mincha shellahem samuch lishkiat hachamma hare niret kinila veenah mitchallefet bemincha shel kol yom. ulefichach yesh bah nesiat kappayim. vechohen sheavar veala ladduchan bemincha shel yom hakkippurim hoil vehaddavar yadua sheen sham shichrut hare ze nose kappav veen moridin oto mippene hachashad shello yomru pasul haya lefichach horiduhu:

Ketzad hi nesiat kappayim baggevulin. beet sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur laavoda kesheyyomar retze kol hakkohanim haomdim bevet hakkeneset neekarin mimmekoman veholchin veolin ladduchan veomdim sham penehem lahechol vaachorehem kelappe haam veetzbeotehem kefufot letoch kappehem ad sheyyashlim sheliach tzibbur hahodaa umachzirin penehem kelappe haam ufoshtin etzbeotehen umagbihin yedehem keneged kitfehem umatchilin <small>(Bamidbar 6 24)</small> "yevarechcha". usheliach tzibbur makre otam milla milla vehem onin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "amor lahem" ad sheyyomar. keshemmashlimin pasuk rishon kol haam onin amen. vechozer sheliach tzibbur umakre otan pasuk sheni milla milla vehem onim ad shemmashlimin pasuk sheni vechol haam onin amen. vechen befasuk shelishi:

Kesheyyashlimu hakkohanim shelosha pesukim matchil sheliach tzibbur beracha acharona shel tefilla shehi sim shalom vehakkohanim machzirin penehem kelappe hakkodesh vekoftzin etzbeotehen veomdin sham badduchan ad sheyyigmor habberacha vechozrin limkoman:

En hammakre rashshay (lehakerot lakkohanim) ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil babberacha ad sheyyichle haddibbur mippi hammakre. veen hatztzibbur onin amen ad shettichle habberacha mippi hakkohanim. veen hakkohanim matchilin bivracha acheret ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. veen sheliach tzibbur rashshay laanot amen achar hakkohanim kishar haam shemma tittaref dato velo yeda ezo beracha makre otan, im pasuk sheni o pasuk shelishi:

En hakkohanim rashshain lehachazir penehem min hatztzibbur ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur sim shalom. veen hakkohanim rashshain leaker mimmekoman ad sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur sim shalom. veen rashshain lachof kishre etzbeotehem ad sheyyachaziru penehem min hatztzibbur. umittakkanot [ ezra] shello yaalu hakkohanim ladduchan besandelehen ella omdin yechefin:

Kesheyyihyu hakkohanim mevarchin et haam lo yabbitu baam velo yassichu datan ella yihyu enehem keneged haaretz keomed bitfilla. veen adam rashshay lehistakkel bifne hakkohanim beshaa shehen mevarchin et haam kede shello yassichu datam. ella kol haam mitkavvenin lishmoa habberacha umechavvenim penehem keneged pene hakkohanim veenam mabbitim bifnehem:

Im haya hakkohen hamevarech echad matchil levarech meatzmo. usheliach tzibbur makre oto milla milla kemo sheamarnu. hayu shenayim o yoter enan matchilin levarech ad sheyyikra lahem sheliach tzibbur veomer lahem kohanim vehem onin veomrim <small>(Bamidbar 6 24)</small> "yevarechcha". vehu makre otan milla milla al hasseder sheamarnu:

Ketzad birkat kohanim bammikdash. hakkohanim olin ladduchan achar sheyyashlimu hakkohanim avodat tamid shel shachar. umagbihin yedehem lemala al gabbe rashehen veetzbeotehen peshutot. chutz mikkohen gadol sheen magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz. veechad makre otan milla milla kederech sheosin baggevulin ad sheyyashlimu shelosha happesukim. veen haam onin achar kol pasuk ella osin otah bammikdash beracha achat. uchesheyyashlimu kol haam onim baruch Adonai elohim elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam:

Veomer et hashshem kichtavo vehu hashshem hannehge miyyud hei vav hei. veze hu hashshem hameforash haamur bechol makom. uvammedina omrim oto bechinnuyo vehu beAlef dalet. sheen mazkirin et hashshem kichtavo ella bammikdash bilvad. umishshemmet shimon hatztzaddik pasku hakkohanim millevarech bashshem hameforash afillu bammikdash kede shello yilmod oto adam sheeno chashuv vesheeno hagun. velo hayu chachamim harishonim melammedin shem ze letalmidehem uvenehem hahagunim ella paam achat lesheva shanim. kol ze gedulla lishmo hannichbad vehannora:

En birkat kohanim neemeret bechol makom ella bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "ko tevarachu et bene yisrael". kach lamdu mippi hashshemua mimmoshe rabbenu alav hashshalom ko tevarchu baamida. ko tevarchu binsiat kappayim. ko tevarchu bilshon hakkodesh. ko tevarchu panim keneged panim. ko tevarchu bekol ram. ko tevarchu beshem hameforash. vehu sheyyihye bammikdash kemo sheamarnu:

En hakkohanim rashshain bechol makom lehosif beracha al sheloshet happesukim kegon <small>(Devarim 1 11)</small> "Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem kachem elef peamim" vechayyotze bah lo bekol ram velo belachash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 2)</small> "lo tosifu al haddavar". beshaa shekkol kohen ole ladduchan keshehu oker raglav laalot omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettihye beracha zo shetztzivvitanu levarech et ammecha yisrael beracha shelema veal yehi bah michshol veavon meatta vead olam. vekodem sheyyachazir panav levarech et haam mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu levarech et ammo yisrael beahava. veachar kach machazir panav latztzibbur umatchil levarcham. ucheshemmachazir panav min hatztzibbur achar shemmashlim omer asinu ma sheggazarta alenu ase immanu ma shehivtachtanu <small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim uvarech et ammecha et yisrael":

Keshemmachzirin hakkohanim et penehem latztzibbur levarcham ucheshemmachzirin penehem min hatztzibbur achar shemmevarchin lo yachaziru ella al derech yamin bechol makom. vechen kol pinnot sheyyihye adam pone lo yihyu ella al derech yamin:

Bammikdash mevarchin birkat kohanim paam achat beyom achar tamid shel shachar. bain veomdin al maalot haulam umevarchin kederech sheamarnu. aval bammedina mevarchin otah achar kol tefilla chutz mimmincha kemo sheamarnu. bechol makom mishtaddelin sheyyihye hammakre otan yisrael shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "amor lahem" mikkelal sheen hammakre mehem:

Shishsha devarim monin nesiat kappayim. hallashon. vehammumin. vihaavera. vehashshanim. vehayyayin. vetumat hayyadayim. hallashon ketzad. haillegim sheen motziin et haotiyyot ketikkunan kegon shekkorin laalefin aynin uleaynin alefin o leshibbolet sibbolet vechayyotze bahen en nosin et kappehen. vechen kevede pe uchevede lashon sheen divrehem nikkarim lakkol en nosin et kappehen:

Hammumin ketzad. kohen sheyyesh mumin befanav o beyadav o beraglav kegon shehayu etzbeotav akummot o akkushshot o shehayu yadav bohakaniyyot lo yissa et kappav lefi shehaam mistakkelin bo. mi shehaya riro yored al zekano beshaa shehu medabber vechen hassuma beachat meenav lo yissa et kappav. veim haya dash beiro vehakkol hayu regilim beze hassuma beachat meenav o beze sheriro zav muttar lefi sheen mistakkelin bo. vechen mi shehayu yadav tzevuot istis ufua lo yissa et kappav. veim rov anshe hair melachtan bechach muttar lefi sheen mistakkelin bo:

Haavera ketzad. kohen sheharag et hannefesh af al pi sheasa teshuva lo yissa et kappav shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "yedechem damim maleu" uchetiv <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "uvefarischem kappechem" vegomer. vechohen sheavad kochavim ben beones ben bishgaga af al pi sheasa teshuva eno nose et kappav leolam shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 23 9)</small> "ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot" vegomer. uveracha kaavoda hi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 10 8)</small> "lesharto ulevarech bishmo". vechen kohen shehemir leakkum af al pi shechazar bo eno nose et kappav leolam. ushear haaverot en monin:

Hashshanim ketzad. kohen naar lo yissa et kappav ad sheyyitmalle zekano. vehayyayin ketzad. mi sheshshata reviit yayin bevat achat eno nose et kappav ad sheyyasir et yeno mealav lefi shehukkesha beracha laavoda. shata reviit yayin bishte peamim o shennatan letocho meat mayim muttar. veim shata yoter merviit af al pi shehaya mazug af al pi sheshshetao bechamma peamim lo yissa et kappav ad sheyyasir et yeno mealav. vechamma hi reviit etzbaim al etzbaim berum etzbaim vachatzi etzba vechomesh etzba begudal. veze haetzba shemmoshchin bo bechol hattora kullah hu haggudal vehu hannikra bohen yad:

Tumat hayyadayim ketzad. kohen shello natal et yadav lo yissa et kappav ella notel et yadav ad happerek kederech shemmekaddeshin laavoda veachar kach mevarech shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 134 2)</small> "seu yedechem kodesh uvarachu et Adonai". vehechalal eno nose et kappav lefi sheeno bechihuno:

Kohen shello haya lo davar mikkol ellu haddevarim hammonin nesiat kappayim af al pi sheeno chacham veeno medakdek bemitzvot o shehayu habberiyyot merannenim acharav o shello haya massao umattano betzedek hare ze nose et kappav veen monin oto lefi shezzo mitzvat ase al kol kohen vechohen sherauy linsiat kappayim veen omrim leadam rasha hosef resha vehimmana min hammitzvot:

Veal titma vetomar uma toil birkat hedyot ze. sheen kibbul habberacha taluy bakkohanim ella behakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 27)</small> "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem". hakkohanim osim mitzvatan shennitztauu bah vehakkadosh baruch hu verachamav mevarech et yisrael kecheftzo:

Am shehem achore hakkohanim enam bichlal habberacha. vehaomdim mitztziddehen hare hem bichlal habberacha. veim hayta mechitztza ben hakkohanim uven hammitbarchim afillu hi choma shel barzel hoil ufenehem mul pene hakkohanim hare hem bichlal habberacha:

Nesiat kappayim baasara vechohanim min hamminyan. bet hakkeneset shekkullan kohanim kullam nosim et kappehem. ulemi hem mevarchim leachehem shebbatztzafon velaachehem shebbaddarom. umi one acharehem amen hannashim vehattaf. veim nisharu sham asara kohanim yoter al ellu shealu ladduchan haasara onin amen vehashshear mevarchin:

Tzibbur shello haya bahen kohen ella sheliach tzibbur levaddo lo yissa et kappav. veim hayta havetachato shehu nose et kappav vechozer litfillato rashshay. veim en lahem kohen kelal kesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lesim shalom omer elohenu velohe avotenu barchenu babberacha hameshulleshet battora hakketuva al yede moshe avdecha haamura mippi aharon uvanav kohanim am kedoshecha kaamur <small>(Bamidbar 6 24)</small> "yevarechcha Adonai veyishmerecha" <small>(Bamidbar 6 25)</small> "yaer Adonai panav elecha vichunnekka" <small>(Bamidbar 6 26)</small> "yissa Adonai panav elecha veyasem lecha shalom" <small>(Bamidbar 6 27)</small> "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem". veen haam onin amen. umatchil veomer sim shalom:

Kohen shennasa et kappav bevet hakkeneset vehalach levet hakkeneset acher umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin velo higgiu levirkat kohanim nose yadav lahen umevarchan. vaafillu kamma peamim beyom. kohen shello akar raglav mimmekomo laalot ladduchan beshaa sheamar sheliach tzibbur retze shuv eno ole beotah tefilla. aval im akar raglav laalot af al pi shello higgia ladduchan ella achar avoda hare ze ole umevarech:

Kol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan af al pi shebbittel mitzvat ase achat hare ze keover al shalosh ase shenneemar (Bamidbar 6 23) "ko tevarachu et bene yisrael" (Bamidbar 6 23) "amor lahem" (Bamidbar 6 27) "vesamu et shemi". vechol kohen sheeno mevarech eno mitbarech vechol kohen hamevarech mitbarech shenneemar (Bereshit 12 3) "vaavaracha mevarchecha":
seliku hilchot tefila besiyyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1: Paamayim bechol yom korin keriat shema, baerev uvabboker. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "uveshachbecha uvekumecha" beshaa shedderech bene adam shochvin veze hu layla. uveshaa shedderech bene adam omdin veze hu yom:

Uma hu kore, shelosha parashiyyot. ellu hen <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" <small>(Bamidbar 15 37)</small> "vayyomer". umakdimin likrot parashat shema mippene sheyyesh bah yichud hashshem veahavato vetalmudo shehu haikkar haggadol shehakkol taluy bo. veachareha vehaya im shamoa sheyyesh bah tziuuy al (zechirat) shear kol hammitzvot. veachar kach parashat <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "tzitzit" sheggam hi yesh bah tziuuy zechirat kol hammitzvot:

Af al pi sheen mitzvat tzitzit noheget ballayla korin otah ballayla mippene sheyyesh bah zichron yetziat mitzrayim umitzva lehazekir yetziat mitzrayim bayyom uvallayla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha". ukeriat shalosh parashiyyot ellu al seder ze hi hannikret keriat shema:

Hakkore keriat shema keshehu gomer pasuk rishon omer belachash baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vechozer vekore kedarko <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" ad sofah. velamma korin ken. masoret hi beyadenu shebbeshaa shekkibbetz yaakov avinu et banav bemitzrayim bishat mitato tzivvam vezerzam al yichud hashshem veal derech Adonai shehalach bah avraham veyitzchak aviv veshaal otam veamar lahem banay shemma yesh bachem paslut mi sheeno omed immi beyichud hashshem kainyan sheamar lanu moshe rabbenu <small>(Devarim 29 17)</small> "pen yesh bachem ish o ishsha" vegomer. anu kullam veamru <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". kelomar shema mimmennu avinu yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. patach hazzaken veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. lefichach nahagu kol yisrael lomar shevach sheshshibbeach bo yisrael hazzaken achar pasuk ze:
Hakkore keriat shema mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. bayyom mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha. uvallayla mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha:

Beracha rishona shellefaneha bayyom yotzer or uvore choshech vechulei uveracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu. veshel achareha emet veyatztziv. uveracha rishona shellefaneha ballayla maariv aravim vechulei sheniyya lah ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta kulei. uveracha rishona shel achareha emet veemuna. sheniyya lah hashekivenu:

Beracha rishona shellefaneha ben bayyom ben ballayla poteach bah bevaruch vechotem bah bevaruch. ushear birchoteha chotem bechol achat mehen bevaruch veen lahem peticha bevaruch. berachot ellu im shear kol habberachot haaruchot befi kol yisrael ezra hassofer uvet dino tikkenum veen adam rashshay lifchot mehem velo lehosif alehem. makom shehitkinu lachtom bevaruch eno rashshay shello lachtom. umakom shehitkinu shello lachtom eno rashshay lachtom. makom shehitkinu shello liftoach bevaruch eno rashshay liftoach. makom shehitkinu liftoach eno rashshay shello liftoach. kelalo shel davar kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot hare ze toe vechozer umevarech kammatbea. vechol sheeno omer emet veyatztziv beshacharit veemet veemuna bearvit lo yatza yede chovato:

Hikdim beracha sheniyya livracha rishona ben bayyom ben ballayla ben lefaneha ben leachareha yatza lefi sheen seder babberachot. beshacharit patach yotzer or vesiyyem maariv aravim lo yatza. patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beyotzer or yatza. uvaerev patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beyotzer or lo yatza. patach beyotzer or vesiyyem bemaariv aravim yatza. shekkol habberachot holchot achar chatimatan:

Eze hu zeman keriat shema ballayla. mitzvatah mishsheat yetziat hakkochavim ad chatzi hallayla. veim avar veicher vekara ad shello ala ammud hashshachar yatza yede chovato shello amru ad chatzot ella kede leharechik adam min happeshia:

Hakkore keriat shema shel arvit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar kodem hanetz hachamma lo yatza yede chovato ella im ken haya anus kegon shikkor o chole vechayyotze bahen. veanus shekkara beet ze eno omer hashekivenu:

Vee ze hu zemanna bayyom. mitzvatah sheyyatchil likrot kodem hanetz hachamma kede sheyyigmor likrot ulevarech beracha acharona im hanetz hachamma. veshiur ze kemo [issur] shaa kodem shettaale hashshemesh. veim icher vekara keriat shema achar shettaale hashshemesh yatza yede chovato sheonatah ad sof shalosh shaot bayyom lemi sheavar veicher:

Mi shehikdim vekara keriat shema shel shacharit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar af al pi shehishlim kodem shettanetz hachamma yatza yede chovato. uvishat haddechak kegon shehaya mashkim latzet ladderech kore lechattechilla mishsheala ammud hashshachar:

Hakkore achar shalosh shaot bayyom afillu haya anus lo yatza yede chovat keriat shema beonato. ella hare hu kekore battora. umevarech lefaneha uleachareha kol hayyom afillu icher vekara achar shalosh shaot:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2: Hakkore et shema velo kivven libbo befasuk rishon shehu <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael" lo yatza yede chovato vehashshear im lo kivven libbo yatza. afillu haya kore battora kedarko o maggiah et happarashiyyot haellu beonat keria yatza vehu shekkivven libbo befasuk rishon:

Kol adam korin kedarkan ben omdin ben mehallechin ben shochvin ben rochvin al gabbe behema. veasur likrot keriat shema vehu muttal ufanav tuchot bakkarka o mushlach al gabbo ufanav lemala. aval kore hu vehu shochev al tziddo. veim haya baal basar harebe veeno yachol lehithappech al tziddo o shehaya chole note meat letziddo vekore:
Mi shehaya mehallech al raglav omed befasuk rishon vehashshear kore vehu mehallech. haya yashen metzaarin oto umeirin oto ad sheyyikra pasuk rishon umikkan veelach im anasattu shena en metzaarin oto:

Mi shehaya osek bimlacha mafsik ad sheyyikra parasha rishona kullah. vechen haummanin betelin mimmelachtan befarasha rishona kede shello tehe keriatan aray, vehashshear kore hu kedarko veosek bimlachto. afillu haya omed berosh hailan o berosh hakkotel kore bimkomo umevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
Haya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman keriat shema posek vekore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. haya osek betzarche rabbim lo yifsok ella yigmor iskehen veyikra im nishar et likrot:

Haya osek baachila o shehaya bammerchatz o shehaya osek betisporet o shehaya mehappech beorot o shehayu oskin baddin gomer veachar kach kore keriat shema. veim haya mityare shemma yaavor zeman keria ufasak vekara hare ze meshubbach:

Mi sheyyarad litbol im yachol laalot ulehitkassot kodem shettanetz hachamma yaale veyitkasse veyikra. veim haya mityare shemma tanetz hachamma kodem sheyyikra yitkasse bammayim shehu omed bahen veyikra. velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim sherechan ra velo beme hammishre velo bemayim tzelulin mippene sheervato niret bahen. aval mitkasse hu bemayim achurin sheen rechan ra vekore bimkomo:

Hakkore keriat shema lo yirmoz beenav velo yikrotz bisfatav velo yare beetzbeotav kede shello tihye keriato aray. veim asa ken af al pi sheyyatza yede chovato hare ze megunne. vetzarich lehashemia leazno keshehu kore veim lo hishmia leazno yatza. vetzarich ledakdek beotiyyotav veim lo dikdek yatza:

Ketzad yedakdek. yishmor shello yarpe hechazak velo yachazik harafe velo yaniach hannad velo yanid hannach. lefichach tzarich litten revach ben haddevakim ben kol shete otiyyot haddomot sheachat mehen sof teva vehaacheret techillat teva hassemucha lah. kegon bechol levavcha kore bechol veshohe vechozer vekore levavcha. vechen vaavadtem mehera. hakkanaf petil. vetzarich levaer zayin shel tizkeru. vetzarich lehaarich bedalet shel echad kede sheyyamlichehu bashshamayim uvaaretz uvearba ruchot. vetzarich shello yachtof bachet kede shello yehe keomer e chad:
Kore adam et shema bechol lashon sheyyihye mevinah. vehakkore bechol lashon tzarich lehizzaher middivre shibbush shebbeoto hallashon umedakdek beoto hallashon kemo shemmedakdek bilshon hakkodesh:

Hakkore lemafrea lo yatza. bamme devarim amurim beseder happesukim aval im hikdim parasha lefarasha af al pi sheeno rashshay ani omer sheyyatza lefi sheenah semucha lah battora. kara pasuk vechazar ukerao paam sheniyya hare ze megunne. kara milla achat uchefalah kegon shekkara shema shema meshattekin oto:

Keraah serugin yatza. afillu shaha ben serug leserug kede ligmor et kullah yatza. vehu sheyyikra al hasseder. keraah mitnamnem vehu mi sheeno er velo nirdam beshena yatza. uvilvad sheyyihye er befasuk rishon:

Safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara chozer vekore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. aval im yada shekkara venistappek lo im berech lefaneha uleachareha o lo berech eno chozer umevarech. kara vetaa yachazor lammakom shettaa. neelam mimmennu ben parasha lefarasha veeno yodea e zo parasha hishlim vee zo tzarich lehatechil chozer lefarasha rishona shehu <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" vegomer:

Taa beemtza happerek veeno yodea lehechan pasak chozer lerosh happerek. haya kore uchetavtam veeno yodea im hu beuchetavtam shel shema o beuchetavtam shebbivhaya im shamoa chozer leuchetavtam shel shema. veim nistappek lo achar shekkara lemaan yirbu yemechem eno chozer sheal hergel leshono hu holech:

Haya kore ufaga baacherim o pagu bo acherim. im haya ben perek leferek posek umatchil veshoel shelom mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon sheppaga beaviv o rabbo o mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma. umeshiv shalom lechol adam shennatan lo shalom:

Haya kore beemtza happarasha eno posek umatchil lishl ella bishlom mi shehu mityare mimmennu kegon melech o annas vechayyotze bahen. aval mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon aviv o rabbo im natan lo shalom techilla posek umeshiv lo shalom:

Veellu hen ben happerakim. ben beracha rishona lashsheniyya. ben sheniyya lishma. ben shema livhaya im shamoa. ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer. ben happerakim haellu shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam. aval ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv hare ze keemtza happerek velo yafsik ella lishl mippene hayyira ulehashiv mippene hakkavod:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3: Hakore et shema rochetz yadav bammayim kodem sheyyikra. higgia zeman keriatah velo matza mayim kodem sheyyikra lo yeacher keriatah veyelech levakkesh mayim ella mekanneach yadav beafar o bitzror o bekora vechayyotze bahen vekore:

En korin lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse af al pi sheen bo tzoa velo bevet hakkevarot velo betzad hammet atzmo veim hirchik arba ammot min hakkever o min hammet muttar likrot. vechol mi shekkara bemakom sheen korin bo chozer vekore:

Bet hakkisse hechadash shehuchan vaadayin lo nishtammesh bo muttar likrot keriat shema lenegdo aval lo betocho. merchatz hechadash muttar likrot betocho. hayu shene battim zimmen echad mehem levet hakkisse veamar al hashsheni veze. hare hashsheni safek im hizmino lechach im lo. lefichach en korin bo lechattechilla veim kara yatza. amar gam ze hare shenehem mezummanin veen korin bahen. chatzar hammerchatz vehu hammakom shebbene adam omdin bo levushin muttar likrot bo keriat shema:

Velo keriat shema bilvad ella kol inyan shehu middivre hakkodesh asur leamro bevet hammerchatz uvevet hakkisse vaafillu amaro bilshon chol. velo leamro bilvad ella afillu lehareher belibbo bedivre tora bevet hakkisse uvevet hammerchatz uvimkom hattinofet vehu hammakom sheyyesh bo tzoa ume raglayim asur:

Devarim shel chol muttar leamran bilshon kodesh bevet hakkisse. vechen hakkinnuyim kegon rachum vechannun veneeman vechayyotze bahen muttar leamran bevet hakkisse. aval hashshemot hameyuchadim vehen hashshemot sheenan nimchakin asur lehazekiran bevet hakkisse uvevet hammerchatz yashan. veim nizdammen lo lehaferish min davar haasur bevet hammerchatz o bevet hakkisse mafrish vaafillu bilshon kodesh uveinyene kodesh:

Tzoat haadam vetzoat kelavim vachazirin bizman sheyyesh betochan orot vechol tzoa sherechah ra kegon ellu asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan. vechen keneged me raglayim shel adam. aval me raglayim shel behema korin kenegdan. katan sheeno yachol leechol kezayit dagan bichde sheyyochal haggadol kishlosha betze dagan en marchikin lo mitztzoato velo mimme raglav:

Hayta tzoa yevesha kecheres asur likrot kenegdah. veim hayta yevesha yoter mecheres ad sheim zerakah titparech hare hi keafar umuttar likrot kenegdah. me raglayim shennivleu bakkarka im hayu martivin hayyad asur likrot kenegdan veim lav muttar:

Kamma yarchik adam mitztzoa umimme raglayim veachar kach yikra, arba ammot. bamme devarim amurim bizman shehem millaachorav o mitztziddav aval im hayu keneged panav marchik mehen ad shello yire otan veachar kach yikra:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya immahen babbayit bemakom shave aval im haya sham makom gavoah mehen asara tefachim o namuch mehem asara tefachim yoshev betzad hammakom vekore shehare nifsak benehem. vehu shello yaggia lo reach ra. vechen im kafa keli al hatztzoa o al meme raglayim af al pi shehen immo babbayit hare ellu kikvurin umuttar likrot kenegdan:

Haya beno uven hatztzoa mechitztza shel zechuchit af al pi shehu roe otah meachare hazzechuchit muttar likrot betziddah. natan reviit mayim letoch me raglayim shel paam achat muttar likrot immahen betoch arba ammot:

Hayta tzoa beguma omed besandalo al hagguma vekore. vehu shello yihye sandalo nogea bah. hayta kenegdo tzoa meuta beyoter kemo tippa rokek aleha rok ave ad shettitkasse vekore. hayta netishat tzoa al besaro o yadav metunnafot mibbet hakkisse velo haya lahen reach ra kelal mippene katnan o yavshutan muttar likrot lefi sheen lahen reach ra. aval im hayta bimkomah af al pi sheenah niret keshehu omed hoil veniret keshehu yoshev asur likrot ad sheyyekanneach yafe yafe mippene shehatztzoa lacha hi veyesh lah reach ra. vechamma geonim horu sheasur lo likrot im hayu yadav metunnafot vechach rauy laasot:

Reach ra sheyyesh lo ikkar marchik 4 ammot vekore im pasak hareach. veim lo pasak hareach marchik ad makom sheppasak hareach. vesheen lo ikkar kegon mi sheyyatza mimmennu ruach millematta marchik ad makom shettichle hareach vekore. geraf shel rei vaavit shel meme raglayim asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan veaf al pi sheen bahen kelum veen lahem reach ra mippene shehem kevet hakkisse:
Tzoa overet kegon shehayta shata al pene hammayim asur likrot kenegdah. ufi chazir ketzoa overet dami veasur likrot kenegdo ad sheyyaavru mimmennu arba ammot:

Haya kore vehiggia limkom hattinnofet lo yanniach yado al piv veyikra ella yafsik ad sheyyaavor meoto makom. vechen hakkore sheyyatzta mimmennu ruach millematta yafsik ad shettichle baashah vechozer likriato. vechen bedivre tora. yatzta ruach mechavero af al pi shemmafsik likriat shema eno posek ledivre tora:

Haya kore keriat shema bevayit venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o meme raglayim o en sham hare ze muttar likrot. haya kore baashpa venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o en sham lo yikra ad sheyyivdok shechezkat haashpa shehi mekom hattinnofet. aval sefek me raglayim afillu baashpa muttar likrot:

Keshem sheasur likrot keneged tzoa ume raglayim ad sheyyarchik kach asur likrot keneged haerva ad sheyyachazir panav. afillu kuti o katan lo yikra keneged ervatan afillu mechitztza shel zechuchit mafseket hoil vehu roe otah asur likrot ad sheyyachazir panav. vechol guf haishsha erva lefichach lo yistakkel beguf haishsha keshehu kore vaafillu ishto. veim haya megulle tefach miggufah lo yikra kenegdah:

Ucheshem shehu asur keneged ervat acherim kach hu asur likrot keneged ervato velo yikra keshehu arom ad sheyyechasse ervato. hayta chagora shel beged o or o sak al matnav af al pi sheshshear gufo arom muttar lo likrot keriat shema vehu shello yihye akevo nogea beervato. haya yashen betallito vehaya arom chotzetz betallito mittachat libbo vekore. aval lo yachotz tzavvaro veyikra mippene shellibbo roe et haerva venimtza kemi shekkore belo chagora:

Shenayim shehayu yeshenim betallit achat kol echad mehen asur likrot af al pi sheyyechasse mittachat libbo ad shettehe tallit mafseket benehen ad shello yigga besar ze bivsar ze mimmatnav ulematta. veim haya yashen im ishto o banav uvene beto hakketannim hare gufan kegufo veeno margish mehen. lefichach af al pi shebbesaro nogea bahem machazir panav vechotzetz mittachat libbo vekore:

Ad ematay hem ketannim leinyan ze ad sheyyehe hazzachar ben shetem esre shana veyom echad vehannekeva bat achat esre shana veyom echad vehu sheyyehe tavnitam ketavnit gedolim <small>(Yechezkel 16 7)</small> "shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach". veachar kach lo yikra ad shettafsik tallit benehen. aval im adayin lo hayu shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach kore immahen bekeruv basar veeno tzarich hefsek ad sheyyihye hazzachar ben 13 shana veyom echad vehannekeva bat shetem esre shana veyom echad:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 4: Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mikkeriat shema. umelammedin et hakketannim likrotah beonatah umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha kede lechannechan bemitzvot. mi shehaya libbo tarud venechpaz lidvar mitzva patur mikkol hammitzvot umikkeriat shema. lefichach chatan shennasa betula patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyavo aleha. lefi sheen dato penuya shemma lo yimtza lah betulim. veim shaha ad motzae shabbat velo baal chayyav likrot mimmotzae shabbat veelach shehare nitkarra dato velibbo gas bah af al pi shello baal:
Aval hannose et habbeula af al pi sheosek bemitzva chayyav likrot hoil veen lo davar shemmevalbel dato. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shemmet lo met shehu chayyav lehitabbel alav patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyikberennu mippene sheen dato penuya likrot. veim haya meshammer et hammet af al pi sheeno meto patur mikkeriat shema. veim hayu hashshomrim shenayim haechad meshammer vehashsheni nishmat lemakom acher vekore vechozer umeshammer venishmat haacher vekore. vechen hachofer kever lemet patur mikkeriat shema:

En motziin et hammet lekavro samuch lizman keriat shema ella im ken haya adam gadol. veim hitchilu vehotziu vehiggia zeman hakkeria vehen melavvin et hammet. kol sheyyesh lammitta tzorech bahen kegon nose hammitta vechillufehen vechillufe chillufehen ben shehayu lifne hammitta ben shehayu leachar hammitta peturin. ushear hamelavvin sheen lammitta tzorech bahen chayyavin:

Hayu asukim behesped vehiggia zeman keriat shema bizman shehammet munnach lifnehen nishmatim echad echad vekorin vechozrin lahesped. en hammet muttal lifnehem kol haam korin keriat shema vehaavel yoshev vedomem lefi sheeno chayyav likrot ad sheyyikbor et meto:

Kavru et hammet vechazru haavelim lekabbel tanchumin vechol haam holchim acharehem mimmekom hakkever lammakom sheomdim bo haavelim laasot shura lekabbel tanchumin. im yecholin haam lehatechil veligmor afillu pasuk echad kodem sheyyaggiu lashshura yatchilu veim lav lo yatchilu ella yenachamu et haavelim veachar sheyyippatru mehen yatchilu likrot. bene adam haomdin bashshura, happenimiyyim shehen roin pene haavelim peturin mikkeriat shema vehachitzonim hoil veenan roin et haavelim chayyavin bikriat shema bimkoman:

Kol mi shehu patur millikrot keriat shema im ratza lehachamir al atzmo likrot kore. vehu shettehe dato penuya alav. aval im haya ze happatur millikrot mevohal eno rashshay likrot ad shettityashshev dato alav:

Kol hattemein chayyavin bikriat shema umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha vehen betumatan. af al pi sheefshar lahen laalot mittumatan bo bayyom kegon hannogin besheretz o benidda vezava umishkavah vechayyotze bahen. veezra uvet dino tikkenu shello yikra bedivre tora baal keri levaddo vehotziuhu mikkelal shear hattemein ad sheyyitbol. velo pashta takkana zo bechol yisrael velo haya koach berov hatztzibbur laamod bah lefichach batla. uchevar nahagu kol yisrael likrot battora velikrot keriat shema vehen baale kerayin lefi sheen divre tora mekabbelin tuma ella omdin betohoratan leolam shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 23 29)</small> "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai" ma esh enah mekabbelet tuma af divre tora enam mekabbelin tuma:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 1:
Bet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hem ikkar tora shebbeal pe. vehem ammude hahoraa umehem chok umishpat yotze lechol yisrael. vaalehen hivticha tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha" zo mitzvat ase. vechol hammaamin bemoshe rabbenu uvetorato chayyav lismoch maase haddat alehen velishshaen alehen: 
Kol mi sheeno ose kehoraatan over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "lo tasur mikkol haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usemol". veen lokin al lav ze mippene shennittan leazharat mitat bet din. shekkol chacham shemmore al divrehem mitato bechenek shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 12)</small> "vehaish asher yaase vezadon" vegomer. echad devarim shellamdu otan mippi hashshemua vehem tora shebbeal pe. veechad devarim shellemmadum mippi datam beachat min hammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen venira beenehem sheddavar ze kach hu. veechad devarim sheasaum seyag lattora ulefi ma shehashshaa tzericha vehen haggezerot vehattakkanot vehamminhagot. kol echad veechad meellu hashshelosha devarim mitzvat ase lishmoa lahen. vehaover al kol echad mehen over belo taase. hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha" ellu hattakkanot vehaggezerot vehamminhagot sheyyoru bahem larabbim kede lechazzek haddat uletakken haolam. veal hammishpat asher yomru ellu devarim sheyyilmedu otan min haddin beachat min hammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen. mikkol haddavar asher yaggidu lecha zo hakkabbala shekkibbelu ish mippi ish: 
Divre kabbala en bahen machloket leolam vechol davar shettimtza bo machloket beyadua sheeno kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu. udevarim shellemedin min haddin im hiskimu alehen bet din haggadol kullan hare hiskimu. veim nechleku bahen holchin achar harov umotziin haddin achar harabbim. vechen haggezerot vehattakkanot vehamminhagot im rau miktzatan sherauy ligzor gezera o letakken takkana o sheyyanichu haam hamminhag hazze verau miktzatan sheen rauy ligzor gezera zo velo letakken takkana zo velo lehaniach minhag ze nosin venotnin ellu keneged ellu veholchin achar rubban umotziin haddavar achar harabbim: 
Keshehaya bet din haggadol kayyam lo hayta machloket beyisrael. ella kol din shennolad bo safek leechad miyyisrael shoel levet din shebbeiro. im yadu amru lo. im lav hare hashshoel im oto bet din o im sheluchav olin lirushalayim veshoalin levet din shebbehar habbayit. im yadu amru lo. im lav hakkol bain levet din sheal petach haazara. im yadu amru lahen veim lav hakkol bain lelishkat haggazit levet din haggadol veshoalin. im haya haddavar shennolad bo hassafek lakkol yadua etzel bet din haggadol ben mippi hakkabbala ben mippi hammidda sheddanu bah omrim miyyad. im lo haya haddavar barur etzel bet din haggadol danin bo bishatan venosin venotnin baddavar ad sheyyaskimu kullan. o yaamdu leminyan veyelchu achar harov veyomru lechol hashshoalim kach halacha veholchin lahen. mishshebbatal bet din haggadol ravta machloket beyisrael ze metamme venoten taam lidvarav veze metaher venoten taam lidvarav ze oser veze mattir: 
Shene chachamim o shene batte dinin shennechleku shello bizman hassanhedrin o ad shello haya haddavar barur lahen. ben bizman echad ben baze achar ze. echad metaher veechad metamme echad oser veechad mattir. im encha yodea lehechan haddin note. beshel tora hallech achar hammachmir beshel sofrim hallech achar hammekel:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 2:
Bet din haggadol sheddarshu beachat min hammiddot kefi ma shennira beenehem shehaddin kach vedanu din. veamad acharehem bet din acher venire lo taam acher listor oto. hare ze soter vedan kefi ma shennire beenav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 9)</small> "el hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem". encha chayyav lalechet ella achar bet din shebbedorcha: 
Bet din sheggazru gezera o tikkenu takkana vehinhigu minhag ufashat haddavar bechol yisrael. veamad acharehem bet din acher uvikkesh levattel devarim harishonim velaakor otah hattakkana veotah haggezera veoto hamminhag. eno yachol ad sheyyihye gadol min harishonim bechachma uveminyan. haya gadol bechachma aval lo beminyan. beminyan aval lo bechachma. eno yachol levattel et devarav. afillu batal hattaam shebbiglalo gazru harishonim o hitkinu en haacharonim yecholin levattel ad sheyyehu gedolim mehem. veheach yihyu gedolim mehem beminyan hoil vechol bet din uvet din shel shivim veechad hu. ze minyan chachme haddor shehiskimu vekibbelu haddavar sheamru bet din haggadol velo chalku bo: 
Bamme devarim amurim bidvarim shello asru otan kede laasot seyag lattora ella kishar dine tora. aval devarim sherau bet din ligzor uleasran laasot seyag im pashat issuran bechol [yisrael] en bet din gadol acher yachol leakran ulehattiran afillu haya gadol min harishonim: 
Veyesh levet din laakor af devarim ellu lefi shaa af al pi shehu katan min harishonim shello yehu gezerot ellu chamurin middivre tora atzmah sheafillu divre tora yesh lechol bet din leakro horaat shaa. ketzad. bet din sherau lechazzek haddat velaasot seyag kede shello yaavru haam al divre tora. makkin veonshin shello kaddin aval en kovin haddavar ledorot veomrim shehalacha kach hu. vechen im rau lefi shaa levattel mitzvat ase o laavor al mitzvat lo taase kede lehachezir rabbim laddat o lehatztzil rabbim miyyisrael millehikkashel bidvarim acherim osin lefi ma shetztzericha hashshaa. keshem sheharofe chotech yado o raglo shel ze kede sheyyichye kullo kach bet din morim bizman min hazzemannim laavor al ketzat mitzvot lefi shaa kede sheyyitkayyemu [kullam] kederech sheamru chachamim harishonim challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe: 
Bet din shennire lahen ligzor gezera o letakken takkana o lehanehig minhag tzerichin lehityashshev baddavar veleda techilla im rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bahen o im en yecholin laamod. uleolam en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bah: 
Hare sheggazru bet din gezera vedimmu sherov hakkahal yecholin laamod bah. veachar sheggezaruha pikpeku haam bah velo pashta berov hakkahal hare zo betela veenan rashshain lachof et haam lalechet bah: 
Gazru vedimmu sheppashta bechol yisrael veamad haddavar ken shanim rabbot uleachar zeman merubbe amad bet din acher uvadak bechol yisrael veraa sheen otah haggezera poshetet bechol yisrael. yesh lo reshut levattel vaafillu haya pachut mibbet din harishon bechachma uveminyan: 
Vechol bet din shehittir shene devarim al yemaher lehattir davar shelishi: 
Hoil veyesh levet din ligzor veleesor davar hammuttar veyaamod issuro ledorot vechen yesh lahen lehattir issure tora lefi shaa. mahu ze shehizhira tora <small>(Devarim 13 1)</small> "lo tosif alav velo tigra mimmennu". shello lehosif al divre tora velo ligroa mehen velikboa haddavar leolam bedavar shehu min hattora ben battora shebbichtav ben battora shebbeal pe. ketzad. hare katuv battora <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze hakkatuv asar levashshel vleechol basar bechalav. ben besar behema ben besar chayya. aval besar haof muttar bechalav min hattora. im yavo bet din veyattir besar chayya bechalav hare ze gorea. veim yeesor besar haof veyomar shehu bichlal haggedi vehu asur min hattora hare ze mosif. aval im amar besar haof muttar min hattora veanu neesor oto venodia laam shehu gezera shello yavo min haddavar chova veyomru haof muttar mippene shello nitparesh kach hachayya mutteret shehare lo nitparsha. veyavo acher lomar af besar behema mutteret chutz min haez. veyavo acher lomar af besar haez muttar bachalev para o hakkivsa shello neemar ella immo shehi mino. veyavo acher lomar af bachalev haez sheenah immo muttar shello neemar ella immo. lefichach neesor kol basar bechalav afillu besar of. en ze mosif ella ose seyag lattora. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 3:
Mi sheeno mode battora shebbeal pe eno zaken mamre haamur battora. ella hare ze bichlal haeppikorosin [umitato bechol adam]: 
Meachar shennitparsem shehu kofer battora shebbeal pe [moridin oto] velo maalin vahare hu kishar kol haeppikorosin vehaomrin en tora min hashshamayim vehammosrin vehammumarin. shekkol ellu enam bichlal yisrael veen tzarich lo leedim velo hateraa velo dayyanim [ella kol hahoreg echad mehen asa mitzva gedola vehesir hammichshol]: 
Bamme devarim amurim beish shekkafar battora shebbeal pe bemachashavto uvidvarim shenniru lo. vehalach achar dato hakkalla veachar sherirut libbo vechofer battora shebbeal pe techilla ketzadok uvaytos vechen kol hattoim acharav. aval bene hattoim haelle uvene benehem shehiddichu otam avotam venoldu ben hakkaraim vegiddelu otam al datam. hare hu ketinok shennishba benehem vegiddeluhu veeno zariz leechoz bedarche hammitzvot shehare hu keanus veaf al pi sheshshama achar kach [shehu yehudi veraa hayehudim vedatam hare hu keanus shehare giddeluhu al tautam] kach ellu sheamarnu haochazim bedarche avotam hakkaraim shettau. lefichach rauy lehacheziran bitshuva ulemashcham bedivre shalom ad sheyyachzeru leetan hattora: 
Aval zaken mamre haamur battora hu chacham echad mechachme yisrael sheyyesh beyado kabbala vedan umore bedivre tora kemo sheyyadunu veyoru kol chachme yisrael. shebbat lo machloket bedin min haddinim im bet din haggadol velo chazar ledivrehem ella chalak alehem vehora laasot shello kehoraatan. gazra alav tora mita umitvadde veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. af al pi shehu dan vehen danim hu kibbel vehem kibbelu hare hattora chalka lahem kavod. veim ratzu bet din limchol al kevodan ulehannicho enan yecholin kede shello yarbu machloket beyisrael: 
En zaken mamre chayyav mita ad sheyyehe chacham shehiggia lehoraa samuch bassanhedrin veyachlok al bet din bedavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat o bitfillin veyore laasot kehoraato. o yaase hu al pi horaato veyachlok alehen vehen yoshvin belishkat haggazit. aval im haya talmid shello higgia lehoraa vehora laasot patur. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 8)</small> "ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat" mi shello yippale mimmennu ella davar mufla: 
Haya chacham mufla shel bet din vechalak veshana velimmed laacherim kidvarav aval lo hora laasot patur. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 12)</small> "vehaish asher yaase vezadon" lo sheyyomar bezadon ella yore laasot o yaase hu beatzmo: 
Metzaan chutz limkoman vehimra alehen patur. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 8)</small> "vekamta vealita el hammakom" melammed shehammakom gorem lo mita. vechol ellu vechayyotze bahen shehen peturin min hammita yesh levet din haggadol lenaddotam ulehafrishan ulehakkotan ulemanan millelammed kefi ma sheyyerae lahen shehaddavar tzarich lechach: 
Vechetzad danin zaken mamre. beet sheyyippale davar veyore bo chacham hammaggia lehoraa ben bedavar sheyyerae beenav ben bedavar shekkibbel merabbotav. hare hu vehacholkin immo olin lirushalayim uvain levet din sheal petach har habbayit. omrim lahen bet din kach hu haddin. im shama vekibbel mutav veim lav bain kullan levet din sheal petach haazara veomrim lahem gam hem kach hu haddin. im kibbelu yelchu lahen veim lav kullan bain levet din haggadol lelishkat haggazit shemmishsham tora yotzet lechol yisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 10)</small> "min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai". uvet din omer lahem kach hu haddin veyotzin kullan. chazar ze hechacham leiro veshana velimmed kederech shehu lamud hare ze patur. hora laasot o sheasa kehoraato chayyav mita veeno tzarich hateraa. afillu natan taam lidvarav en shomin lo ella kevan shebbau edim sheasa kehoraato o shehora laacherim laasot gomrin dino lemita bevet din shebbeiro. vetofsin oto umaalin oto mishsham lirushalayim. veen memitin oto bevet din shebbeiro velo bevet din haggadol sheyyatza chutz lirushalayim ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim. vead haregel meshammerin oto vechonkin oto baregel. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 12)</small> "vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau" mikkelal shetztzarich hacheraza. vearbaa tzerichin hacheraza. zaken mamre. veedim zommin. vehammesit. uven sorer umore. shehare bechullan neemar yishmeu veyirau:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 4:
Ze shechalak al bet din haggadol bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. ben shehayu hen osrim vehu mattir ben shehayu hen mattirin vehu oser hare ze chayyav mita. afillu hu haya omer mippi hakkabbala veamar kach kibbalti merabbotay vehen omrim kach nire beenenu shehaddin noten. hoil venasa venatan alehen baddavar veasa o shehora laasot hare ze chayyav. veen tzarich lomar im hem morim mippi hakkabbala. vechen im chalak alehem bigzera min haggezerot sheggazru bedavar sheyyesh beshiggato chattat uzedono karet. kegon shehittir hechametz beyom arbaa asar benisan beshaa shishshit. o asaro bahanaa beshaa chamishit. hare ze chayyav mita. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Echad shennechleku bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. o shennechleku bedavar hammevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. ketzad. nechleku beishsha zo im hi erva im lav. im mare dam ze metamme beishsha o lo. im zo temea leda o lo. im zo zava o lo. im chelev ze asur o muttar. vechol kayyotze beellu. hare ze cholek bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. vechetzad davar hammevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat kegon shennechleku beibbur shana im meabberim ad happurim o bechol adar hare ze chayyav shezze mevi lide chametz befesach. vechen im nechleku bedin middine mamonot o beminyan haddayyanin sheddanin dine mamonot hare ze chayyav. shehare lidvarav shel ze sheomer shezze chayyav laze kol shennatal mimmennu kedin natal veal pi bet din natal. velidvarav shel ze sheomer patur o sheamar sheen ellu reuyin ladun kol shennatal gezel hu beyado veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. uledivre haomer shello natal habba aleha bemezid anush karet beshogeg chayyav chattat venimtza haddavar mevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. vechen im nechleku bedine makkot im ze chayyav malkot o eno o shechalak beminyan haddayyanim shellokin bifnehem hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer eno loke chovlin hem bo vechayyavin leshallem vechol sheyyittol mehen kedin notel. uledivre haomer ben malkot hu kol sheyyittol mehen gezel hu beyado veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im nechleku baarachin o bacharamin im ze chayyav litten o eno hare ze chayyav. shehare ledivre haomer eno chayyav litten im lakchu mimmennu hare ze gezel vehamekaddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im chalak alehen befidyon kadashim im nifdu o lo nifdu hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer en ze pidyon im kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im nechleku baarifat haegla im ellu chayyavin lehavi o lo hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer chayyavim lehavi hare hi asura bahanaa vehamekaddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im nechleku bearla. vechen im nechleku beleket shichcha ufea im ze laaniyyim o levaal habbayit hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer levaal habbayit hare ze gezel beyad heani veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im chalak alehen beav meavot hattuma kegon nige basar o nige battim o nige begadim hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer tahor muttar lehikkanes bammikdash leechol kadashim uledivre haomer tame im nichnas o achal bemezid anush karet uveshogeg chayyav chattat. vechen im nechleku betohorat metzora im yesh laze tohora o en lo. vechen im nechleku behashekaat sota im zo tzericha lishtot o enah tzericha hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer tzericha im met habbaal kodem shettishte hare zo asura livamah uledivre haomer enah tzericha mityabbemet. vechen kol kayyotze baze tzerichin livdok velachkor im hayta machloket zo mevia lide davar ze vedavar ze mevi lide davar sheni afillu achar mea devarim im yavo bassof ledavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat. ben shehaya hazzaken mekel vehen machamirin ben shehaya hu machmir vehen mekilin chayyav: 
Veim lo tavi hammachaloket lide kach hare ze patur. chutz mimmitzvat tefillin bilvad. ketzad. hora lehosif totefet chamishit battefillin veyaasenna chamesh totafot hare ze chayyav. vehu sheyyaase battechilla arbaa battim kehilchatan veyavi chamishit vidabbek bachitzon. shehabbayit hachitzon sheeno roe et haavir tamid pasul. vechiyyuv zaken mamre al davar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala. aval im nechleku bishar mitzvot kegon shechalak bedavar middivre lulav o tzitzit o shofar ze omer pasul veze omer kasher. ze omer yatza yede chovato veze omer lo yatza. ze omer tahor veze omer sheni letuma hare ze patur min hammita. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 5:
Hamekalel aviv veimmo niskal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 9)</small> "aviv veimmo killel damav bo". veechad hamekallel bechayyehen o leachar mitatan hare ze niskal. vetzarich edim vehateraa kishar kol mechuyyave mitot bet din. veechad haish veechad haishsha vechen hattumtum vehaanderoginus. vehu sheyyihyu gedolim shehiggiu lichlal hoonashin: 
Eno chayyav sekila ad sheyyekallelem beshem min hashshemot hammeyuchadin. aval im killelam bechinnuy patur min hassekila. veloke kederech shelloke al killat kol adam kasher miyyisrael: 
Vechen hamekallel avi aviv vaavi immo hare ze kimkallel echad mishshear hakkahal: 
Azhara shel mekallel aviv veimmo minnayin. onesh shamanu beferush aval haazhara hare hi bichlal lo tekallel cheresh. hoil vehu muzhar shello lekallel adam miyyisrael hare aviv bichlal yisrael: 
Hammakke aviv veimmo mitato bechenek shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 15)</small> "makke aviv veimmo mot yumat". vetzarich edim vehateraa kishar kol mechuyyave mitat bet din. veechad haish veechad haishsha vechen hattumtum veanderoginus vehu sheyyaggiu lichlal onashin. eno chayyav chenek ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura aval im lo asa bahen chabbura hare ze kemakke echad miyyisrael. vehammakke otan leachar mita patur: 
Mi shehikka et aviv al azno vechersho chayyav veneherag. shei efshar sheyyease cheresh belo chabbura ella yatzat tippat dam bifnim baozen venitcharesh: 
Hammakkiz dam leaviv o shehaya rofe vechatach lo basar o evar patur. af al pi shehu patur lechattechilla lo yaase. o lehotzi sillon mibbesar aviv o immo lo yotzi shemma yaase chabbura. bamme devarim amurim kesheyyesh sham acher laasot. aval im en sham mi sheyyaase ella hu vahare hen mitztaarin hare ze makkiz vechotech kefi ma sheyyarshehu laasot: 
Azhara shel makke aviv minnayin. onesh shamanu azhara lo shamanu. hoil vehu muzhar shello lehakkot adam miyyisrael hare aviv veimmo bichlal: 
Shetuki chayyav al immo veeno chayyav al aviv af al pi shennivdeka immo veamra ben peloni hu eno niskal o nechnak al piha. aval beno min hashshifcha umin haakkum eno chayyav lo al aviv velo al immo. vechen ger shehorato shello bikdushsha af al pi shelledato bikdushsha eno chayyav al makkat aviv vekillato: 
Keshem sheeno chayyav al aviv kach eno chayyav al immo. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 17)</small> "umekallel aviv veimmo" et shehu chayyav al aviv chayyav al immo veze sheeno chayyav al aviv eno chayyav al immo: 
Hagger asur lekallel aviv haakkum ulehakkoto. velo yevazzehu kede shello yomru bau mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla shehare ze mevazze aviv. ella noheg bo miktzat kavod. aval haeved en lo yichus ella hare aviv kemi sheeno aviv lechol davar af al pi shennishtachreru: 
Mi shehayu aviv veimmo reshaim gemurim veovre averot. afillu nigmar dinan lahariga vehem yotzim lehareg asur lehakkotan ulekallelam. veim killel o chaval bahen patur. veim asu teshuva hare ze chayyav veneherag alehen af al pi shehare hen yotzin lemita. bamme devarim amurim bivno. aval acher shebba vehikkahu vekillel achar shennigmar dino af al pi sheasa teshuva hare ze patur hoil vehu holech lemita. veim biyyesho chayyav biknas hamevayyesh:
