Avar aviv veimmo al avera shellokin aleha vehaya hu chazzan lifne haddayyanim lo yakke otam. vechen im nitchayyev nidduy lo yihye shaliach lenaddotam. velo yidchof otam velo yevazze otam bishlichut bet din af al pi shehen reuyin lechach velo asu teshuva: 
Lakkol en habben naase shaliach lehakkoto ulekallelo chutz mimmesit umaddiach. shehare amra tora <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "lo tachmol velo techasse alav": 
Mi shennitchayyev shevua livno kach rainu bo tamid sheeno mashbio bishvuat haala. shehare ze ba lekillat aviv. ella mashbio shevua sheen bah ala. uchevar bearnu shehaav sheharag et beno en echad meechav shel neherag naase goel haddam. velo al hakkaa velo al hakkelala bilvad hikpida tora ella af al habbizzayon. shekkol hamevazze aviv o immo afillu bidvarim vaafillu birmiza hare ze arur mippi haggevura. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 16)</small> "arur makle aviv veimmo". vahare hu omer <small>(Mishlei 30 17)</small> "ayin tilag leav vetavuz likkehat em" vegomer. veyesh levet din lehakkot al ze makkat mardut velaanosh kefi ma sheyyiru:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 6:
Kibbud av vaem mitzvat ase gedola vechen mora av vaem. shakal otan hakkatuv bichvodo uvemorao. katuv <small>(Shemot 20 12)</small> "kabbed et avicha veet immecha" vechatuv <small>(Mishlei 3 9)</small> "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha". uveaviv veimmo katuv <small>(Vayikra 19 3)</small> "ish immo veaviv tirau" vechatuv <small>(Devarim 6 13)</small> "et Adonai elohecha tira". kederech shetztzivva al kevod shemo haggadol umorao kach tzivva al kevodam umoraam: 
Hamekallel aviv o immo biskila vehamegaddef biskila. hinne hishva otan baonesh. hikdim av leem lechavod vehikdim em leav lemora lelammed sheshshenehem shavim ben lammora ben lechavod: 
E zehu mora vee zehu kavod. mora lo omed bimkomo. velo yoshev bimkomo. velo soter et devarav velo machria et devarav. velo yikra lo bishmo lo bechayyav velo bemoto. ella omer abba mari. haya shem aviv o shem rabbo keshem acherim meshanne et shemam. yerae li sheen nizhar bechach ella beshem shehu pele sheen hakkol dashin bo. aval hashshemot shekkorim bahen et haam kegon avraham yitzchak veyaakov moshe vechayyotze bahen bechol lashon uvechol zeman kore bahen laacherim shello befanav veen bechach kelum. e zehu kavod maachil umashke malbish umechasse mishshel haav. veim en mamon laav veyesh mamon labben kofin oto vezan aviv veimmo kefi ma shehu yachol. umotzi umachnis umeshammesho bishar haddevarim shehashshammashim meshammeshim bahen et harav. veomed mippanav kederech shehu omed mippene rabbo: 
Vehaav shehaya talmid beno en haav omed mippene habben aval habben omed mippene aviv af al pi shehu talmido vechayyav lechabbedo bishar derachav bishat asiyyat massao umattano vaasiyyat chafatzav. ketzad. hannishma bidvar aviv lemakom lo yomar maharuni bishvil atzmi pitruni bishvil atzmi. ella maharuni bishvil abba pitruni bishvil abba. vechen kol kayyotze baze. leolam yichlol bichlal devarav shehu choshesh bichvod aviv veshemmityare mimmennu: 
Vechayyav lechabbedo afillu leachar moto. ketzad. haya omer devar shemua mippiv lo yomar kach amar abba. ella omer kach amar abba mari ani kapparat mishkavo. bamme devarim amurim betoch shenem asar chodesh shelleachar mitato. aval leachar shenem asar chodesh omer zichrono lechayye haolam habba: 
Echad haish veechad haishsha chayyavin bemora vechavod. ella shehaish yesh beyado laasot vehaishsha en beyadah laasot shehare reshut acherim aleha. lefichach im nitgarsha o nitalmena hare shenehem shavim: 
Ad hechan hu kibbud av veem. afillu natlu kis shel zehuvim shello vehishlichu befanav layyam lo yachlimem velo yetzaer bifnehem velo yichos kenegdam ella yekabbel gezerat hakkatuv veyishtok. vead hechan moraan afillu haya lovesh begadim chamudot veyoshev barosh bifne hakkahal uva aviv veimmo vekaru begadav vehikkuhu berosho veyarku befanav lo yachlimem ella yishtok veyira veyifchad mimmelech malche hammelachim shetztzivvahu bechach. sheillu melech basar vadam gazar alav davar shehu metzaer yeter mizze lo haya yachol lefarkes baddavar. kal vachomer lemi sheamar vehaya haolam kirtzono: 
Af al pi shebbechach nitztavvenu asur leadam lehachebid ello al banav uledakdek bichvodo immahem shello yeviem lide michshol. ella yimchol veyitallem shehaav shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul: 
Vehammakke beno gadol menaddin oto shehare hu over al velifne ivver lo titten michshol: 
Mi shennitrefa dato shel aviv o shel immo mishtaddel linhog immahem kefi datam ad sheyyerucham alehen. veim i efshar lo laamod mippene shennishtattu beyoter yenichem veyelech lo vitzavve acherim lehanehigam karauy lahem: 
Hammamzer chayyav bichvod aviv umorao af al pi shehu patur al makkato vekillato ad sheyyaase teshuva. afillu haya aviv rasha uvaal averot mechabbedo umityare mimmennu. raahu over al divre tora lo yomar lo abba avarta al divre tora ella yomar lo abba katuv battora kach vechach keillu hu shoel mimmennu velo kemazhiro: 
Mi sheamar lo aviv laavor al divre tora ben sheamar lo laavor al mitzvat lo taase o levattel mitzvat ase afillu shel divrehem. hare ze lo yishma lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 3)</small> "ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru". kullechem chayyavin bichvodi: 
Amar lo aviv hashekeni mayim veyesh beyado laasot mitzva im efshar lammitzva shettease al yede acherim tease veyitassek bichvod aviv sheen mevattelin mitzva mippene mitzva. veim en sham acherim laasotah yitassek bammitzva veyaniach kavod aviv shehu veaviv chayyavim bidvar mitzva. vetalmud tora gadol mikkevod av vaem: 
Amar lo aviv hashekeni mayim veamra lo immo hashekeni mayim meniach kevod immo veosek bichvod aviv techilla mippene shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv: 
Chayyav adam lechabbed et eshet aviv af al pi sheenah immo kol zeman sheaviv kayyam shezze bichlal kevod aviv. vechen mechabbed baal immo kol zeman sheimmo kayyemet. aval leachar mitatah eno chayyav. umiddivre sofrim sheyyihye adam chayyav bichvod achiv haggadol kichvod aviv:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 7:
Ben sorer umore haamur battora hare nitparsha bo sekila velo anash hakkatuv ella im ken hizhir. vehechan hizhir lo tochlu al haddam lo tochal achila hammevia lide shefichut damim vezo achilat ben sorer umore sheeno neherag ella al achila mechoeret sheachal. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "zolel vesove" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzolel hu haochel basar beraavtanut vesove hashshote yayin beraavtanut: 
Achila zo shehu chayyav aleha devarim harebe yesh bahem vehen kullan halacha mippi hakkabbala. eno chayyav sekila ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyikne basar bezol veyayin bezol. veyochal veyishte chutz mershut aviv bachavura shekkullan rekanin ufechutin. veyochal habbasar chay veeno chay mevushshal veeno mevushshal kederech shehaggannavim ochlim. veyishte hayyayin mazug kederech shehaggargeranim shotim. vehu sheyyochal mishkal chamishshim dinarin mibbasar ze bimlugema achat veyishte chatzi log miyyayin ze bevat achat. ganav mishshel aviv veachal achila zo birshut aviv. o shegganav mishshel acherim veachal achila zo hamechoeret ben birshut aviv ben birshut acherim. hare ze patur. vechen im ganav mishshel aviv veachal achila mechoeret kazo birshut acherim vehayta achilat mitzva afillu middivrehem [o achilat avera afillu middivrehem] patur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "enennu shomea beklenu" sheeno over baachila zo ella al kolam. yatza ze sheavar bah al divre tora. o sheachalah bidvar mitzva. ketzad. achal achila zo hamechoeret im hachavura haraa sheochel immahem bidvar mitzva. o sheachalo maaser sheni birushalayim afillu achalo betanchume avelim shehi mitzva middivrehem hare ze patur. vechen im achalah minnevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim. afillu achal betaanit tzibbur shehi avera middivrehem. hare ze patur min hammita: 
Achal kol maachol velo achal besar behema af al pi sheachal achila zo mibbesar haof patur. veim achal achila zo mibbesar behema vehishlim hachamishshim dinarim mibbesar haof chayyav. shata kol mashke velo shata yayin patur: 
Achal basar chay veshata yayin chay patur shezze keri hu veen adam yachol lehimmashech baze. vechen im achal basar maliach bayyom hashshelishi limlichato o shata yayin miggitto patur sheen adam yachol lehimmashech baze: 
Lo anash hakkatuv katan shello ba lichlal hammitzvot. vechen ish sheggadal vahare hu birshut atzmo eno niskal mippene shegganav veachal veshata achila zo hamechoeret. ha ketzad. mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen din ze ella beven shelosh esre shana veyom echad shehevi shete searot ad sheyyakkif kol haggid veachar sheyyakkif hassear kol haggid hare hu birshut atzmo veeno niskal: 
Kol yamav shel ben sorer umore enan ella shelosha chodashim meachar sheyyavi shete searot. lefi sheefshar shettitabber ishto veyihye ubbarah nikkar bishlosha chodashim veneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "ki yihye leish ben sorer umore" velo av sorer umore ha lamadta sheim hikkif hassear et kol haggid kodem sheyyashlim shelosha chodashim hare ze patur: 
Ketzad danin ben sorer umore. meviin oto aviv veimmo techilla levet din shel shelosha veomrin lahen benenu ze sorer umore. umeviin shene edim shegganav mishshel aviv vekana basar veyayin bema shegganav veachal otah achila haamura achar hahatraa. vezo hi edut harishona umalkin oto kishar chayyave malkot. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "veyisseru oto velo yishma alehem". chazar veganav mishshel aviv veachal achila zo. aviv veimmo meviin oto levet din shel shelosha veesrim umeviin shene edim umeidin alav shegganav veachal achila zo haamura achar shehitru bo. vezo hi edut acharona afillu hayu hashshenayim harishonim hem haacharonim. veachar shemmekabbelin edutan bodkin oto shemma hikkif hassear et kol haggid. im lo hikkif velo shalmu lo shelosha chodashim gomrin dino kederech kol haruge bet din vesoklin oto. veeno niskal ad sheyyehu sham shelosha harishonim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "benenu ze" zehu shellaka bifnechem: 
Veim machalu lo aviv veimmo kodem sheyyiggamer dino patur: 
Barach ad shello nigmar dino veachar kach hikkif hassear millematta patur. veim mishshennigmar dino barach afillu hizkin kol et sheyyimmatze yissakel shekkol mi shennigmar dino hare hu keharug veen lo dam: 
Haya aviv rotze veimmo enah rotza immo rotza veaviv eno rotze eno naase ben sorer umore shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 19)</small> "vetafsu vo aviv veimmo". haya echad mehen giddem o chigger o illem o suma o cheresh eno naase ben sorer umore shenneemar vetafsu vo velo giddemim. <small>(Devarim 21 19)</small> "vehotziu oto" velo chiggerim. <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "veamru" velo illemim. <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "benenu ze" velo sumim. <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "enennu shomea beklenu" velo chershim: 
Gezerat hakkatuv hu sheyyissakel ben sorer umore. aval habbat enah niddonet bedin ze sheen darkah lehimmashech baachila ushetiyya keish. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "ben" velo bat velo tumtum veanderoginus: 
Tumtum shennikra venimtza zachar eno naase ben sorer umore. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "ki yihye leish ben sorer umore" ad sheyyihye ben mishsheat hateraa: 
Ben sorer umore tzarich hacheraza. ketzad machrizin alav. kotvin lechol yisrael bevet din peloni sakalnu peloni mippene shehaya ben sorer umore: 
Ben sorer umore hare hu kechol haruge bet din shemmamonam leyorshehen sheaf al pi sheaviv garam lo sekila hare hu yoresh kol nechasav: seliku lehu hilchot mamrim besad
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 1: Mitzvat para adumma shettihye bat shalosh shanim o bat arba. veim hayta zekena keshera ella sheen mamtinin lah shemma tashchir vetippasel. veen lokchin egla umegaddelin otah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 2)</small> "veyikchu elecha fara" velo egla. lo matzu ella egla poskin aleha damim vetihye etzel bealeha ad shettagdil vetease para. velokchin otah mitterumat hallishka:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 19 2)</small> "temima" temimat admimut lo temimat koma ella im hayta nannasa keshera kishar hakkadashim. hayu bah shete searot levanot o shechorot betoch gumma achat o betoch shene kosot vehen munnachot zo al zo pesula:

Hayu bah shete searot ikkaran maadim veroshan mashchir ikkaran mashchir veroshan maadim hakkol holech achar haikkar. vegozez bemisparayim et roshan hammashchir veeno choshesh mishshum gizza bekadashim sheen kavvanato lagoz:

Vetzarich sheyyishshaer min hammaadim kede sheyyinnatel bezug shekkol seara sheenah nittelet bezug hare hi keillu enah. lefichach im hayu bah shete searot levanot o shechorot sheenan nilkatin bezug hare zo keshera:
Hayu karneha o telafeha shechorim yagod. galgal haayin vehashshinnayim vehallashon en marehen poslim befara:
Hayta bah yabbelet vachatachah. af al pi shetztzamach bimkomah sear adom pesula:

Kol hammumin happoslin bekadashim poslin befara shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 2)</small> "asher en bah mum". hayta yotze dofen o mechir o etnan o terefa o shennirbea pesula. shekkol happoslin et hakkadashim lammizbeach poslin et happara veaf al pi shehi kekadshe bedek habbayit hoil ukeraah hakkatuv chattat. umuttar likkach otah min haakkum veen choshshin shemma revaah haakkum sheeno mafsid behemto. yetera para al hakkadashim shehaavoda poselet bah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 2)</small> "asher lo ala aleha ol" uveegla arufa omer <small>(Devarim 21 3)</small> "asher lo ubbad bah asher lo mashcha beol" ma ol haamur beegla asa shear avodot keol af ol haamur befara yifsol bah shear avodot keol. ella shehaol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda ushear avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda. ketzad. kashar aleha haol af al pi shello charash bah pesula. hichnisah ladush enah nifselet ad sheyyadush bah. vechen kol kayyotze baze. rachav aleha. nishan aleha. nitla biznavah. veavar bah et hannahar. kippel aleha et hammosera. natan tallito aleha. natan aleha kesut shel sakkim. pesula. kesharah bemosera im hayta moredet utzericha shemira keshera veim lav pesula shekkol shemira sheenah tzericha massoy hu. asa bah sandal shello tachllek. peras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvin. keshera. ze hakkelal kol shehu letzarkah keshera letzorech acher pesula. naaset bah melacha meeleha o sheala aleha ol meelav. im lirtzono pesula shenneemar asher lo ubbad bah sheim ubbad bah lirtzono hare ze kemi sheavad bah. lefichach im shachan aleha haof keshera. ala aleha zachar pesula. veen tzarich lomar shehameubberet pesula. hichnisah lirvaka vedasha meeleha keshera. hichnisah kede shettinak vetadush pesula shehare asa lirtzono. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Para shennolad bah pesul tippade. vechen im meta tippade mippene orah. aval lo lehaachil besarah lichlavim:
Nishchata leshem chullin tippade veenah mechapperet. nishchata al gav maarachtah en lah pidyon olamit:
Lakchu para umatzu acheret naa mimmenna hare zo tippade shello bemum:

Af kohen hedyot kasher lisrefat happara shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "unetattem otah el elazar hakkohen" vaadayin aharon haya kayyam. umippi hashshemua lamdu zo naaset beelazar ushear kol happarot ben bechohen gadol ben bechohen hedyot:
Vehaose otah lovesh arbaa kelim shel kohen hedyot. ben sheasaah kohen hedyot ben sheasaah kohen gadol:

Kol haoskin bappara mittechilla vead sof shehayu tevule yom kesherim lemaase happara ulekaddesh ulehazzot meefrah veaf al pi sheadayin lo heeriv shimshan. shezze shenneemar bechol happarasha <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "ish tahor" hu hattahor lemaaser sheni af al pi sheeno tahor litruma ad sheyyaariv shimsho hare ze tahor lefara:

Hatztzedokin hayu omrim sheen maase happara kasher ella bimorave shemesh. lefichach hayu bet din bevayit sheni metammein et hakkohen hassoref et happara besheretz vechayyotze bo vetovel veachar kach osek bah kede levattel divre ellu hazzedim shemmorim mehaole al rucham lo min hakkabbala. vechen kol hakkelim shemmachnisin letocham efer happara kullam tevule yom:

Hachotech shefoferet shel kane lehanniach bah efer chattat yetamme otah veyitbelenna veachar kach yanniach bah. vehachotchah vehammatbilah taun tevila mippene sheasauha kitme met bashshevii shello ulefichach enah tzericha hazzaa shelishi ushevii ella metammeah kede lehareot latztzedokin umatbilah venoten bah:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 2:
Maalot yeterot asu betohorat para adumma veharechakot gedolot hirchiku mittumat hammet bechol maaseha. mippene shehi keshera bitvule yom chashu shemma yavou lezalzel bah. umippene ze keshemmafrishin hakkohen hassoref otah mafrishin oto lelishka muchenet baazara. uvet even hayta nikret mippene shekkol keleha kele avanim sheen mekabbelin tuma. uvichle haeven haya mishtammesh kol shivat yeme hahafrasha. velo hayu nogin bo echav hakkohanim kede leharebot betohorato: 
Shivat yamim kodem serefat happara mafrishin kohen hassoref otah mibbeto. keshem shemmafrishin kohen gadol laavodat yom hakkippurim. vedavar ze kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu. vechen mafrishin oto meishto shemma timmatze nidda veyihye tame shivat yamim: 
Hallishka shehaya yoshev bah kol shiva tzefonit mizrachit hayta. kede lehazekiro shehi kechattat hannishchetet batztzafon af al pi shehi nishchetet bachutz: 
Kol yom veyom mishshivat yeme hahafrasha mazzin alav me chattat. shemma nitma lemet vehu lo yada. chutz miyyom revii lehaferasha sheen tzarich hazzaa lefi shei efshar shello yihye lo shelishi letumato velo shevii. sheen hazzaa bashshevii ola mishshum hazzaat shevii ad sheyyazze bashshelishi millefaneha. umin haddin haya sheen tzarich hazzaa ella bishlishi ushevii lehaferasha bilvad veze shemmazzin yom achar yom maala yetera asu befara: 
Birvii beshabbat hayu mafrishin oto kede sheyyachul revii shello lihyot beshabbat. shehahazzaya enah docha shabbat veharvii en tzarich hazzaya: 
Bechol yom veyom mime hahafrasha shemmazzin alav bahem. mazzin meefer para min happarot shennisrefu kevar. veim lo haya sham ella efer para achat bilvad mazzin mimmennu alav kol hashshishsha: 
Keshemmazzin alav bime hahafrasha en mazze alav ella adam shello nitma bemet meolam shehammaze tzarich sheyyihye tahor. veim tomar yazze alav ish shennitma vehuzza alav. shemma ze shehizza alav lo haya tahor mittumat met. vechen hakkelim shemmemallein bahen umekaddeshin lehazzot al hakkohen hassoref kullam kele avanim hayu sheen mekabbelin tuma. vechol ellu haddevarim maalot yeterot hen sheasu bah. vechetzad yimmatze ish shello nitma bemet meolam. chatzerot hayu birushalayim benuyot al gabbe hassela vetachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom. umeviin hayu nashim ubbarot veyoldot sham umegaddelot sham et benehem. uchesheyyirtzu lehazzot al hakkohen hassoref meviin shevarim mippene shekkeresehen nefuchot umannichim al gabbehen delatot veyoshvin hattinokot al gabbe haddelatot kede sheyyihye haohel mavdil benam leven haaretz mippene kever hattehom. vechosot shel even beyadam veholchin lashshiloach. higgiu lashshiloach yordin sham umemallein sheen lachush sham mippene kever hattehom sheen derech bene adam likbor banneharot. veolin veyoshvin al gabbe haddelatot veholchin ad shemmaggiin lehar habbayit. higgiu lehar habbayit yordin umehallechin al raglehen mippene shekkol har habbayit vehaazarot tachtehen haya chalul mippene kever hattehom. umehallechin ad petach haazara. uvefetach haazara haya kalal shel efer notlin haefer venotnin bammayim shebbakkosot umazzin al hakkohen hassoref. umatbilin hayu hattinokot shemmemallein umekaddeshin umazzin al hassoref af al pi shehen tehorin mittumat hammet shemma nitmeu betuma acheret: 
Tinok shettaval lemalleot ulehazzot lo yemalle bechelav tinok acher af al pi shettaval. vetinok shettaval lehazzot al kohen ze eno mazze al kohen acher ad sheyyitbol leshem maase ze hakkohen. vechen kelim shettiharum lechattat zo uvene adam shettiharum lechattat zo lo yitassek bahem befara acheret ad sheyyitbelu lishmah. vechol haddevarim haellu maalot yeterot befara:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 3:
En sorfin et happara ella chutz lehar habbayit shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "vehotzi otah" el michutz lammachane. uvehar hammishcha hayu sorfin otah. vechevesh hayu osin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha vetachtav banuy kippin kippin vechippa al kol shene kippin kede sheyyihyu shene ragle hakkippa al gag shene kippin shettachteha. kede shettihye tachat hakkol chalul mippene kever hattehom. af mekom serefatah umekom hattevila shehayu behar hammishcha tachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom. vehappara vehassoref vechol hamesaadin bisrefatah yotzin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha al gabbe kevesh ze: 
Ketzad sorfin otah. zikne yisrael hayu makdimin beraglehen lehar hammishcha uvet tevila haya sham. vechohen vehamesaadin bisrefatah vehappara yotzin al hakkevesh uvain lehar hammishcha. umetammein et hakkohen vesomchin hazzekenim et yedehem al hakkohen veomrim lo tevol achat. veim haya kohen gadol omrim lo ishi kohen gadol tevol achat. yarad vetaval veala venistappeg. veetzim mesuddarim hayu sham arazim allonim uveroshim vaatze teena chalaka. veosin maaracha kemin migdal umefattechin bah challonot kede shettihye haur melabbevet bahen. umare hammaaracha bemaarav. vechoftin et happara bechevel shel megeg venotnin otah al gabbe hammaaracha roshah ledarom ufaneha lemaarav. hakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. shochet bimino umekabbel haddam bismolo. umazze beetzbao hayemanit min haddam shebbechappo hassemalit sheva peamim keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim. al kol hazzaa tevilat etzba bedam. usheyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulim lehazzaya lefichach al kol hazzaa mekanneach etzbao begufah shel para. gamar millehazzot mekanneach et yadav begufah shel para veyored min hammaaracha vehitztzit et haesh beetzim ketannim vehichnisan tachat atze hammaaracha vehitchil haesh bah vehakkohen omed berachok umeshammer lah ad sheyyitztzat et haur berubbah vetikkara bitnah. veachar kach notel etz erez veezov en pachot mittefach vetzemer tzavua betolaat mishkal chamishsha selaim veomer laomdim sham. etz erez ze etz erez ze etz erez ze. ezov ze ezov ze ezov ze. sheni tolaat ze sheni tolaat ze sheni tolaat ze. shalosh peamim al kol echad veechad. vehen omrin lo hen hen hen shalosh peamim al kol echad veechad. vechol kach lamma lefi shemmine arazim shiva hen umine ezov arbaa vehatztzavua adom yesh shetztzovin oto befua veyesh shetztzovin oto belakka veyesh shetztzovin oto betolaat vehattolaat hi haggargerim haadummim beyoter haddomim legarine hecharuvim vehen kemo haog vetolaat kemo yattush yesh bechol gargir mehen ulefichach modia lakkol umegalle lahen sheellu hen hamminim haamurim battora. vehaezov haamur battora hu haezov sheochlin oto baale battim umetabbelin bo hakkederot. haezov vehaerez vehattolaat shelashtan meakkevin ze et ze. vechorech haezov im haerez belashon shel shani umashlich el toch bitnah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 6)</small> "vehishlich el toch serefat happara". veeno mashlich kodem sheyyatztzit haur berubbah velo achar shettease efer veim hishlich pesula shenneemar el toch serefat lo kodem sheyyitztzat haur berubbah velo achar shettease efer. ben shehishlich shelashtan keachat ben shehishlich ze achar ze ben shehishlich letoch gufah o letoch serefatah ben shennikrea meeleha veachar kach hishlich ben shekkeraah beyado o bichli keshera: 
Nigmera serefatah chovtin otah bemaklot hi vechol atze hammaaracha shennisrefa bahen vechovrin et hakkol bichvarot vechol shachor sheefshar sheyyikkatesh veyihye efer ben mibbesarah ben min haetzim kotshin oto ad sheyyease efer vesheen bo efer mannichin oto vechol etzem shennishar meatzameha belo serefa ben kach uven kach haya nichtash: 
En machnisin kelum meefrah lehannicho baazara shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "vehinniach michutz lammachane". ushelosha chalakim hayu cholkin et kol efrah echad nittan bachel veechad behar hammishcha veechad mitchallek lechol hammishmarot. ze shemmitchallek lechol hammishmarot hayu hakkohanim mekaddeshin mimmennu. veze shennittan behar hammishcha hayu yisrael mazzin mimmennu. veze shennittan bachel haya muchan umutzna shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret" melammed shemmatzniin mimmennu. vechen hayu matzniin meefer kol para ufara shessorfin bachel. vetesha parot adummot naasu mishshennitztauu bemitzva zo ad shecharav habbayit bashsheniyya. rishona asa moshe rabbenu. sheniyya asa ezra. vesheva meezra ad churban habbayit. vehaasirit yaase hammelech hammashiach mehera yiggale amen ken yehi ratzon:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 4:
En shochatin shete parot adummot keachat shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "veshachat otah": 
Lo ratzta para latzet en motziin immah shechora shello yomru shechora shachatu velo adumma shello yomru shetayim shachatu: 
Para shennishchata shello lishmah o shekkibbel o shehizza shello lishmah o lishmah veshello lishmah o shello lishmah velishmah o shennaaset shello bechohen o bimchussar begadim o sheasaah bevigde zahav o bevigde chol pesula. shechatah al menat leechol mibbesarah o lishtot middamah keshera lefi shello neemar bah reach nichoach: 
Kibbel damah bichli pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 4)</small> "velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao" mitzvatah mitzvat yad velo mitzvat keli: 
Hizza bichli afillu achat mehen hazzaato pesula. hizza achat mehen bismolo pesula. hizzu shiva kohanim hazzayatan keechad hazzayatan pesula. ze achar ze keshera. hizza velo kivven keneged hahechol pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 4)</small> "el nochach pene ohel moed" ad sheyyechavven keneged hahechol veyihye roehu. vechen im shechatah o serafah shello keneged hahechol pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "veshachat otah lefanav": 
Bamme devarim amurim shehizza o saraf o shachat keneged haddarom o keneged tzafon o shehaya achorav lammikdash. aval im amad ben mizrach umaarav ufanav keneged hahechol af al pi shello kivven keneged [hahechol] bedikduk keshera: 
Chisser achat min hammattanot pesula. taval shetayim vehizza achat hazzaato pesula. taval achat vehizza shetayim af al pi shello chashav hazzaa sheniyya ella taval vehizza acheret hazzayato pesula. ketzad. taval etzbao tevila shishshit vehizza shesh vesheva af al pi shechazar vetaval etzbao vehizza sheva hazzayato pesula. hizza mittevila sheviit [sheviit] usheminit afillu chazar vetaval tevila sheminit vehizza sheminit keshera shekkol shemmosif al hashsheva eno kelum. vehu sheyyihye ze shehosif kohen acher aval hakkohen hassoref otah im hosif pesula mippene shennitassek bedavar sheeno tzarich bishat serefatah: 
Hotzi et haddam chutz mimmaarachtah vehizza pesula: 
Hizza middamah ballayla afillu hizza shesh hazzayot bayyom veachat ballayla pesula: 
Shechatah chutz mimmekom serefatah afillu shechatah lefanim min hachoma pesula: 
Serafah chutz mimmaaracha shennishchata aleha. o shechillekah lishnayim userafah bishte maarachot. o shessaraf shetayim bemaaracha achat pesula. veim achar shennaaset efer mevi acheret soref al gabbah veeno choshesh: 
Hifshitah unetachah veachar kach saraf kullah keshera. veim chisser mimmenna kelum afillu mippirshah pesula. paka meorah o mibbesarah afillu missearah kezayit yachzir veim lo hechzir pesula. paka chutz lemaarachtah marbe alav vesorfo bimkomo. paka mikkarneha mittelafeha o mippirshah eno tzarich lehachezir: 
Happara enah nifselet belina lefichach im nishchata hayyom vehizza damah kehilchato venisrefa lemachar keshera: 
Serafah onen o mechussar kappara keshera: 
Serafah shello bekiddush yadayim veraglayim pesula mippene shemmaaseha keen avoda. vehechan mekaddesh yadav veraglav bichli sharet bifnim veim kiddesh bachutz umikkeli chol afillu bimkeda shel cheres kasher hoil vechol maaseha bachutz. vechen keshemmatbilin et hakkohen hassoref achar shemmetammein oto kemo shebbearnu eno tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh hoil vechol maaseha bitvule yom: 
Serafah shello beetzim o bechol etzim afillu bekash o bigvava keshera. umitzvatah shello yemaet lah etzim min harauy lah aval marbe hu lah chavile ezov veezov yon bizman serefa kede leharebot et haefer. veyesh lo leharebot etzim bisrefatah ad shettease efer aval mishshettease efer im hosif bah afillu etz echad hare ze kimarev efer makle beefer happara: 
Kol maase happara mittechilla vead sof eno ella bayyom. uvezichre kehunna. vehammelacha poselet bah ad shettease efer. aval mishshettease efer im kanas efrah ballayla o shekkenasattu ishsha o sheasa melacha acheret bishat kenisato hare zo keshera. uminnayin sheasifat haefer bechol adam miyyisrael chutz mecheresh shote vekatan shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "veasaf ish tahor" mikkelal sheenah tzericha kohen ucheillu amar adam tahor ben ish ben ishsha. uminnayin shehammelacha poselet bah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "veshachat otah" mippi hashshemua lamdu shello ba hakkatuv ella lelammed sheim nitassek bedavar acher bishat shechitatah pesalah veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 5)</small> "vesaraf et happara leenav" sheyyihyu enav bah lelammed shehammelacha poselet bah mishsheat shechita ad shettease efer. vechol haosek bisrefatah veasa melacha acheret pesalah ad shettease efer: 
Shachat et happara venishchata behema acheret immah o nechtecha delaat immah keshera shehare lo nitkavven limlacha af al pi shehabbehema shennishchata immah keshera laachila sheen shechitat hachullin tzericha kavvana. aval im nitkavven lachtoch haddelaat venechtecha bishat shechita pesula shehare asa immah melacha:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 5: Kol haoskin bappara mittechilla vead sof metammein begadim kol zeman asiyyatan shenneemar beshochet umashlich etz erez <small>(Vayikra 15 13)</small> "vechibbes begadav verachatz besaro" veneemar besoref <small>(Bamidbar 19 8)</small> "vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 10)</small> "vechibbes haosef et efer happara" melammed shekkol haoskin bah mittechilla vead sof metammeim begadim uteunin tevila vehaarev shemesh din tora. aval hameshammerah bishat asiyyatah metamme begadim middivrehem gezera shemma yaziz bah evar:

Kol makom shenneemar battora betumot yechabbes begadav lo ba lelammedenu shehabbegadim shealav bilvad hem temeim. ella lelammed shekkol beged o keli sheyyigga bo hattame hazze bishat chibburo bimtammeav hare hen temeim. aval achar sheyyifrosh mimmetammeav eno metamme begadim. ketzad. hannose et hannevela echad beged shealav o keli sheyyigga bo kol zeman shehu nosah hare hen temein vahare hen rishon letuma. vechen ze hannose hare hu rishon. perash mimmetammeav vehishlich et hannevela hare hu rishon kemot shehaya. veim yigga bichli o beged eno metamme oto sheen velad tuma metamme kelim kemo shebbearnu bitchillat sefer ze. vechen kol kayyotze binvela. vechen kol haoskin bappara im naga beveged o bichli bishat shechita o bishat serefa hare hen temein. aval achar sheyyifrosh mimmaaseha af al pi sheadayin lo taval im naga bichli eno metammeo mippene shehu velad hattuma. vehappara atzmah enah metammea lo adam velo kelim shennagu bo. ella hammitassek bah bilvad hu hattame vetaun tevila umetamme begadim kol zeman sheosek bah:

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shennisrefet kemitzvatah. aval im nifsela hammitassek bah tahor. era pissul bishchitatah enah metammea begadim. era pissul behazzayatah kol haosek bah lifne pissulah metamme begadim. leachar pissulah eno metamme begadim:

Hishlim lichnos et efrah hammitassek bah achar ken bechilluk heafar o behatzenaato vechen hannogea bo tahor. velo happara bilvad ella kol hachattaot hannisrafot min happarim umin hasseirim hassorfam metamme begadim bishat serefato ad sheyyeasu efer. shehare hu omer befar vesair shel yom hakkippurim <small>(Vayikra 16 28)</small> "vehassoref otam yechabbes" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze binyan av lechol hannisrafim sheyyehu metammein begadim ad sheyyeasu efer. bamme devarim amurim beshello era lahen pissul venisrefu kemitzvatan bevet haddeshen. aval im nifselu baazara nisrafin sham kifsule hammukdashin vesorfan tahor. vechen hammitassek bahen mishsheyyeasu efer eno metamme begadim. vee zehu soref ze hammassia bisrefa kegon hamehappech babbasar vehammashlich etzim vehamehappech baesh vehachote gechalim kede shettivar haesh vechayyotze bahen. aval hammatztzit haur vehamesadder et hammaaracha tahor. kach lamdu mippi hashshemua shehannose parim useirim hannisrafin lehotzian levet haddeshen lesarfan tame umetamme begadim din tora kol zeman shehu osek beholachatan vetaun tevila vehaarev shemesh. kemo hameshalleach et hassair laazazel shehu metamme kol beged vechol keli sheyyigga bo bechelim shealav kol zeman shemmitassek bishlucho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 26)</small> "vehameshalleach et hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav":

Meematay metammein begadim hannosin parim useirim hannisrafim. mishsheyyetzu bahen chutz lechomat haazara. nesaum bemotot veyatzu miktzat hannosim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu. ellu sheyyatzu metammein begadim veellu sheadayin lo yatzu enan metammein begadim ad sheyyetzu. yatzu vechazru laazara hannose otan baazara tahor ad sheyyetze bahen. haya omed chutz laazara umoshech otam mishsham meachar shechazru hoil uchevar yatzu lachutz vahare ze hammoshcham bachutz hare hu sefek tame:
Umeematay metamme begadim hameshalleach et hassair. mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim ad sheat dechiyyato laazazel. aval achar sheddachahu im naga bechelim uvivgadim tehorim:

Hannogea befarim uvisirin hannisrafin atzman afillu achar sheyyatzu ben adam ben kelim ben ochalin ben mashkin hakkol tahor. vechen im nagu bassair hammishtalleach atzmo bizman holachato tehorin. sheen ellu metammein ella lammitassek bahen bilvad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 8)</small> "vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav" aval hannogea tahor:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 6: Hammayim shennotnin alav efer happara en memallein otan ella bichli. umin hammayanot o min hanneharot hammoshchin. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 17)</small> "venatan alav mayim chayyim el keli". unetinat efer happara al hammayim shennitmalleu hu hannikra kiddush. vehammayim haellu shennittan alehen haefer hen hannikrain me chattat umayim mekuddashin vehem shekkeraan hakkatuv <small>(Bamidbar 19)</small> "me nidda":

Hakkol kesherim lemalleot hammayim chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. vehakkol kesherin lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. veen memallein veen mekaddeshin ella bichli veen mazzin ella mikkeli. vehammilluy vehakkiddush kesherin ballayla aval en mazzin veen tovlin ella bayyom. vechol hayyom kasher lehazzaa velitvila:

Bechol hakkelim memallein umazzin umekaddeshin afillu bichle gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama uvisfina. veechad kele cheres veechad kol hakkelim. aval en memallein veen mekaddeshin velo mazzin bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bimgufat hechavit velo bechafnav velo bevetzat hattarnegolet velo beshoket shebbassela. aval betzat hayyotzrim keshera mippene shehi keli adama:

Shule kele etz uchele zechuchit uchele etzem en mekaddeshin bahen ad sheyyashuf otan vitakkenem veyaasem kelim bifne atzman. vechen megufa shehitkinah lihyot keli mekaddeshin bah. uvetzat hannaamit keshera lekaddesh bah veen tzarich lomar shekkeshera lemalleot bah ulehazzot mimmenna:

Keli shechibbero baaretz o bassela afillu chibbero besid mekaddeshin bo umazzin mimmennu. asa atara shel tit saviv lakkeli vehammayim shebbakkeli tzafin ad shehalchu laatara im nittelet haatara im hakkeli hare hammayim shebbetochah kesherim shehare hen bichli adama veim lav hare hen kemi shehikkif atara shel tit bassela o al haaretz umille otah mayim shehen pesulin mippene sheenan bichli:
Keli cheres shennikkav bechones mashke en memallein umekaddeshin bo aval im nikkav bemotzi mashke mekaddeshin bo:
Keli shennikkav millematta usetamo bismartutin pasul shehammayim shebbo enan al iggul hakkeli ella al happekak. haya nakuv min hatztzad ufekako hare ze kasher lemalleot ulekaddesh ulehazzot mimmennu:

Hazzolef mayim min hammayan beyadav uveraglav uvacharasim venatan letoch hechavit pesulin mippene shello nitmalleu bichli. natan et hechavit bemayim vedachak hammayim beyadav o beraglav o baale yerakot kede sheyyaavru lechavit hare ellu pesulin. vechen im shikkeo bemayim kede sheyyigberu hammayim veyaalu veyishshafchu lechavit pesulin. veim asa ken baale kanim o baale egoz hare hammayim kesherim. ze hakkelal davar shehu mekabbel tuma im siyyea bo hammayim kede sheyyemalleu hakkeli hammayim pesulin veim siyyea bedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma kesherim:
Hamefanne hammayan letoch haggat o letoch haggeve vechazar umille bichli meoto haggeve o haggat pesulim shehare tzarich shettihye lekichat hammayim min hammayan bichli battechilla:
Hayyam haggadol kemikve veeno kemayan lefichach en memallein mimmennu lekiddush. vechol hanneharot pesulin lekaddesh mehen me chattat. ushear hayyammim kemayan:
Vehammayim hannigrarin mishshear hayyammim vehen hannikrain zochalin pesulin. vehazzochalin min hammayan hare hem kemayan uchesherim:

Mayim hammukkin vehamechazzevin pesulin. veellu hen hammukkin hammeluchim o happoshrim vehamechazzevim hem hammayanot sheppeamim mekerin ufeamim charevin viveshin afillu hayu charevin paam achat lesheva shanim pesulin. aval im hayu charevin bishne batztzoret o leshanim rabbot yeter mishsheva o shehayu memehen peamim merubbin ufeamim muatin veenan charevin hare ellu kesherim. umayan hayyotze battechilla kasher veeno tzarich livdok shemma yechazzev:

Me bitztzim ume hayyarden ume hayyarmuch pesulin mippene shehen me hattaarovot. veellu hen me hattaarovot. mayim kesherim lekiddush shennitarvu bemayim pesulin en memallein mittaarovet shenehem. aval mayim kesherim shennitarvu bemayim kesherim kegon meme shete hammayanot shennitarvu venimshechu memallein mehen:
Hammayim shennishtannu shinnuyan mechamat atzman kesherin:
Beer shennafal letochah charsit o adama venaasu memeha achurin memalle mimmenna veen tzarich lehametin. nafal letochah shetef shel meme geshamim yamtin ad shettitztzal:

Ammat hammayim habbaa merachok hoil utechillatah min hammayan keshera lemalleot mimmenna. uvilvad sheyyishmerenna shello yifsekenna adam venimtza memalle min hammayim sheppasku techillatan min hammayan shehen pesulin:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 7:
Hammelacha poselet bemayim kodem sheyyitkaddeshu veenah poselet behazzaa. udevarim ellu hen divre kabbala. ketzad. hamemalle mayim lekiddush venitassek bimlacha acheret bishat hammilluy o bishat holachat hammayim shemmemalle o beet shemmeare otan mikkeli el keli pesalan. leolam hammelacha poselet bemayim ad sheyyatil lahen et haefer. hetil et haefer venitkaddeshu venaasu me nidda en hammelacha poselet bahen ella hammolich hammayim hammukdashin o meare otan mikkeli lichli vehu osek bimlacha acheret en bechach kelum. vechen mazze mehen beyado achat vehu ose melacha beyado haacheret: 
Hassachar pasul bekiddush uvahazzaya veeno posel bemilluy. ketzad. hannotel secharo lekaddesh me chattat o lehazzot mehen hare otan hammayim keme hammeara vehaefer keefer makle sheeno kelum. aval notel hu sachar lemalleot hammayim o leholichan. umekaddeshin otan bechinnam umazze mehen hammazze bechinnam. haya hamekaddesh o hammazze zaken sheeno yachol lehallech al raglav uva hattame uvikkesh mimmennu lahaloch immo bemakom rachok lekaddesh o lehazzot hare ze markivo al hachamor venoten secharo kefoel batel shebbatel meotah melacha shebbittelo mimmenna. vechen im haya kohen vehaya tame betuma hammonato milleechol terumato beet sheyyelech immo lehazzot o lekaddesh hare ze maachilo umashkehu vesacho. veim bittelo mimmelacha noten lo secharo kefoel batel shel otah melacha. shekkol ellu haddevarim enan sachar shennistakker bekiddush o behazzaa shehare lo hirviach kelum velo natal ella keneged ma shehifsid: 
Hamemalle beachat yado veose melacha beyado haacheret o hamemalle lo uleacher o shemmille lishnayim keachat shenehen pesulin shehammilluy melacha venimtza kol milluy mishshenehem keillu asa immo melacha acheret. uchevar hodanu shehammelacha poselet bemilluy ben shemmille leatzmo ben shemmille laacherim: 
Hamemalle laacherim afillu mille elef chaviyyot zo achar zo leelef bene adam kullan kesherim vechol echad mehen notel hammayim shello umekaddeshan. mille leatzmo chavit achar chavit im nitkavven lekabbetz kol hechaviyyot lichli echad ulehashlich alehen et haefer umekaddeshan kiddush echad kullan kesherim shehakkol milluy echad hu. aval im nitkavven lekaddesh kol chavit vechavit bifne atzmah kullan pesulin chutz min haacharona sheharishona nifselet bammelacha sheasa kodem sheyyekaddesh vehu milluy hashsheniyya. vechen hashsheniyya nifselet bemilluy hashshelishit veen keshera ella acharona: 
Chamishsha shemmilleu chamesh chaviyyot lekaddesham chamishsha kiddushim kegon sheyyashlich haefer al kol achat veachat bifne atzmo venimlechu learvan ulekaddeshan kullan kiddush echad o shemmilleum lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlechu lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin kullan kesherin shehare lo nitassek hamemalle bemilluy acher. aval hayyachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot lekaddesham chamishsha kiddushin af al pi shechazar venimlach lekaddeshan kiddush echad en kasher ella acharon. millean lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlach lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin en kasher ella ze shekkiddesh battechilla. vechen im amar leacher kaddesh lecha et ellu en kasher ella zo shennitkaddesha mehen battechilla. aval im amar lo kaddesh li et ellu hare kullan kesherin shehare lekiddush echad millean veaf al pi shennimlach aleha lekaddeshah chamishsha kiddushin hare lo kiddesh hu ella acher kiddesh lo: 
Harotze lemalleot mayim lekaddeshan umayim acherim litzrachav memalle et shel tzerachav techilla vekoshran vetoanan laachorav veachar kach memalle et shel chattat kede shello yitassek bimlacha achar hammilluy venotnam lefanav veholech: 
Shenayim shehayu memallein kol echad veechad leatzmo vehigbihu ze al ze venatal ze laze kotz miyyado o miggufo bishat milluo im milleu shenehem lekiddush echad hammayim kesherim veim milleu lekaddesh kol echad leatzmo ze shehigbiah o hotzi et hakkotz pasal memav: 
Hashshoel chevel lemalleot bo umille venatal hachevel beyadav umemav al ketefo ufaga babbealim bedarko venatan lahen et hachevel keshehu mehallech kesherin. veim yatza min hadderech kede leholich hachevel labbealim pasal et hammayim: 
Mi shehaya memalle umashlich hachevel shemmille bo al haaretz veachar shemmille chazar vekibbetz al yado pesalan. veim haya dole umekabbetz letoch yado hammayim kesherim: 
Hamemalle venoten lechavit ad sheyyemalleenna mayim vehitznia et hechavit shello tishshaver beshaa shehaya memalle o shekkefaah al piha al menat lenaggevah lemalleot bah kasher shezze mitztzorech hammilluy hu. aval im hitzniah o niggevah kede leholich bah et hakkiddush pasal shehare asa melacha sheenah letzorech hammilluy. vechen hamemalle venoten leshoket ufinna charsit min hashshoket bishat milluy im bishvil shettachzik mayim rabbim kesherim shehare zo tzorech hammilluy veim bishvil shello yihyu hacharasin meakkevin oto beshaa shehu zolef et hammayim shemmille bashshoket hare ellu pesulin: 
Hamemalle deli lishtot venimlach vechishshev alav leme chattat im ad shello higgia haddeli lammayim chishshev meare veen tzarich lenaggev veim mishshehiggia haddeli lammayim chishshev meare vetzarich lenaggev veachar kach yemalle bo lechattat. shilshel haddeli venifsak hachevel miyyado im ad shello higgia haddeli lammayim chishshev alav meare veen tzarich lenaggev. nimlach vehu odehu betoch hammayim vechishshev alav leme chattat meare veeno tzarich lenaggev. mayim shemmillean leme chattat veachar shennitmalle chishshev alehen lishtotan kesheyyatte et hakkeli lishtot pasal hammayim af al pi shello shata mehen kelum:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 8:
Mi shehayu memav al ketefo veamad vehora horaa laacherim o sheddan din o shechaltza befanav o meana o shehera laacherim et hadderech o sheharag et nachash o akrav o natal ochalin min hashshuk lehatzeniam hare hammayim pesulin shehare nitassek bedavar acher kodem sheyyitten haefer al hammayim. aval im natal hoochalin leachlan vaachalan keshehu mehallech o sheharag nachash o akrav hameakkevin oto hare hammayim kesherim shezze mitztzorech holachat hammayim. ze hakkelal kol davar shehu mishshum melacha sheasahu kodem mattan haefer ben amad ben lo amad pasal vedavar sheeno mishshum melacha im lo amad kesherim veim amad pasal. haya mehallech bemayim ufaratz bishat hillucho makom sheyyelech bo af al pi shepparatz al menat ligdor kesherim. veim gadar kodem sheyyitten haefer pesulin. vechen im katza perot leechol af al pi shekkavvanato lehaketzot et hashshear kesherin. veim hiktza kodem mattan haefer pasul: 
Haya ochel bishat holachat hammayim vehotir vezarak ma shehotir letachat hatteena o letachat hammuktze im nitkavven shello yovdu happerot hare hammayim pesulin shehare asa melacha. veim zerakan lefi sheen lo tzorech bahen hare hammayim kesherin. hamemalle mayim lekaddeshan umesaran leacher leshamran veasu habbealim melacha lo nifselu hammayim shehare mesaran leshomer. veim asa hashshomer melacha pesalan shehare hen birshuto vehu nichnas tachat habbealim. hayu shenayim shomrin et hammayim veasa echad mehen melacha hammayim kesherim shehare hashsheni meshammer. chazar harishon lishmor veamad hashsheni veasa melacha hammayim kesherim ad sheyyaasu kol hashshomrin melacha keachat: 
Hamekaddesh beachat yado veasa melacha bashsheniyya. im leatzmo kiddesh pasal shehare asa melacha kodem mattan efer bemayim. veim lachavero kiddesh hammayim kesherim sheen ze posel memav shel chavero bammelacha sheasa. sheen hammelacha poselet bekiddush ella bemayim. vehu sheyyihye haose hashshomer o habbealim: 
Hamekaddesh leatzmo uleacher keachat. shello pasul shehare nifselu hammayim shel atzmo beesek shennitassek bekiddush chavero. aval im kiddesh lishnayim keachat shenehem kesherin sheen melachto poselet me acherim: 
Hamemalle leatzmo bishte yadav keachat bekiddush echad pasul. bishne kiddushim kasher. kiddesh leatzmo bishte yadav keachat bekiddush echad kesherim bishne kiddushin pesulin. mille vekiddesh bishte yadav keachat leatzmo shenehen pesulin. mille leacher bishte yadav keachat bekiddush echad kasher bishne kiddushin pesulin. kiddesh leacher bishte yadav keachat ben bekiddush echad ben bishne kiddushin shenehen kesherim. mille vekiddesh bishte yadav keachat leacher hammilluy pasul vehakkiddush kasher. ze hakkelal kol milluy sheasa immo melacha ben shemmille leatzmo ben shemmille leacher pasul. vechol mayim shennitmalleu kehilchatan veasa melacha kodem sheyyitten et haefer im hayu hammayim shello hare hen pesulin. veim hayu shel acher kesherin. vechol davar shebbeyado veasa melacha ben sheyyesh sham shomer sheeno ose melacha ben sheen [sham] shomer pasul. vedavar sheeno beyado veasa melacha im yesh [sham] shomer lo pasal. im en sham shomer pasal: 
Haomer lachavero kaddesh li vaakaddesh lecha vekiddeshu ze laze harishon kasher vehashsheni pasul shehare kiddesh besachar. amar lo malle li vaamalle lecha umilleu ze laze harishon pasul hoil vechavvanato sheyyemalle lo chavero. chelef milluy ze hare ze kimmalle lo uleacher shehen pesulin. vehashsheni kasher shehammilluy besachar muttar vahare lo asa melacha achar shemmille veen bechavvanato milluy acher: 
Haomer lachavero kaddesh li vaamalle lecha shenehen kesherin shehammelacha enah poselet hakkiddush vehammilluy besachar muttar. malle li vaakaddesh lecha shenehen pesulin. ze shemmille battechilla pasul shehare hu kimmalle umekaddesh keachat ufasal hammayim bammelacha. veze shekkiddesh baacharona pasul shehare kiddesh besachar ucheillu hechzir chov shealav: 
Haholech lekaddesh hare ze notel et hammafteach ufoteach lehotzi haefer. venotel kardom im tzarich lachpor bo efer happara. venotel sullam umolich mimmakom lemakom lehavi haefer vechasher. veim mishshennatal haefer lekaddesh bo kissa hakkeli shehaya bo haefer. o shehegif et haddalet o shezzakaf et hakkeli baaretz kodem sheyyashlich haefer lammayim pasal hammayim. aval haefer kasher lekaddesh bo mayim acherim. zakaf et hakkeli sheyyesh bo haefer beyado kede shello yitpazzer kesherim mippene shei efshar shehare im hinnicho baaretz pasal. veim kissahu pasal. natal et haefer veraa shehu merubbe vehechzir mimmennu kasher. natan haefer al hammayim veraa shehu merubbe venatal mimmennu lekaddesh mayim acherim kasher. kirsem ale zayit lachtot bo haefer im bishvil shello yachazik efer harebe pasal veim bishvil sheyyikkanes haefer bakkeli kasher:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 9: Ketzad mekaddeshin et hammayim beefer happara. noten et hammayim shennitmalleu leshem me chattat bakkeli venoten efer al pene hammayim kede sheyyerae al pene hammayim. af al pi shehi chavit gedola melea mayim. umearev hakkol. veim natan haefer techilla veachar kach natan alav hammayim pasal. umahu ze shenneemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 19 17)</small> "venatan alav mayim chayyim". kede learev et haefer bammayim:

Hamekaddesh tzarich sheyyitkavven veyitten haefer beyado al hammayim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 17)</small> "velakchu lattame" ad sheyyihye mitkavven lekiddush ulemilluy ulehazzaya. aval im nafal haefer min hakkeli sheyyesh bo haefer letoch hammayim. o shennatal haefer beyado udechafo chavero o haruach venafal haefer miyyado al hammayim. o shennafal haefer miyyado al tzad hakkeli o al yado veachar kach nafal lammayim hare ze pasul:

Kiddesh pachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzaa bichli acher lo nitkaddeshu. haya haefer tzaf al pene hammayim vechanas mimmennu millemala vekiddesh bo mayim acherim hare ellu mekuddashin. vechol shennaga bammayim en mekaddeshin bo paam sheniyya veaf al pi shenniggevo. vaafillu nashva haruach venatna et haefer al gabbe hammayim eno menaggevo umekaddesh bo:

Keli katan shehaya betoch keli gadol vehen melein mayim vehammayim meoravin kevan shennatan haefer bammayim shebbakkeli haggadol nitkaddeshu kol hammayim shebbetoch hakkeli hakkatan. veaf al pi shehaya piv tzar beyoter velo nichnas lo efer shehare hammayim kullan meoravin:

Haya sefog betoch hammayim beet shennatan haefer hare hammayim shebbassefog pesulin mippene sheenan bakkeli. ketzad yaase. zolef et kol hammayim ad shemmaggia lassefog velo yigga bassefog. veim naga bassefog af al pi shehammayim tzafin al gabbav kol shehen pesulin. mippene shehammayim shebbassefog yotzin umitarvin bammayim hakkesherin. nafal sefog letoch hammayim hamekuddashin notlo vesochato chutz lakkeli vehammayim shebbakkeli kesherin:

Shete shekatot shebbeeven achat shennatan et haefer letoch achat mehen en hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin. veim hayu nekuvot zo lezo kishfoferet hannod o shehayu hammayim tzafin al gabbehen afillu kiklippat hashshum venatan efer leachat mehen hare hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin:

Shete avanim shehikkifan zo lezo vaasaan shoket vechen shete arevot. vechen shoket shennechleka venatan efer bechelek echad mehen. hammayim shebbenehen enan mekuddashin. veim chibberan besid o begafsis vehem yecholot lehinnatel keachat hammayim shebbenehen mekuddashin:

Mayim mekuddashin shennitarvu bahen mayim acherim kol shehu afillu mayim shennitmalleu lekiddush hare ellu pesulin. vechen im yarad letochan tal hare ellu pesulin. nafal letochan mashkin ume perot yeare hakkol vetzarich lenaggev hakkeli veachar ken yitten letocho mayim mekuddashin acherim. nafal letochan deyo komos vekankantom vechol davar shehu roshem yeare veen tzarich lenaggev. sheim yishshaer sham davar haroshem hare hu nire:

Hammatbil keli lechattat bemayim sheenan reuyin lekaddesh tzarich lenaggev veachar kach yekaddesh bo. hitbilo bemayim haruyin lekaddesh eno tzarich lenaggev. veim hitbilo leesof bo mayim mekuddashin ben kach uven kach tzarich lenaggev:

Keruya shehitbilah bemayim haruyin lekaddesh mekaddeshin bah. aval en osfin letochah me chattat mippene shehammayim shehutbela bahen nivlaim betochah veyotzin umitarvin beme chattat ufoslin otan. nitmet vehitbiluha en mekaddeshin bah shehammashkin hattemein hannivlain begufah yetzu veyitarvu bammayim shemmekaddeshin otan betochah:

Mayim mekuddashin shennafal letochan shekatzim uremasim venitbakkeu o shennishtannu marehen pesulin. afillu hayu yeveshim beyoter kegon hannemala veharira vehakkinna shebbattevua. natan letochah chippushin af al pi shello nitbakkeu velo nishtannu marehen hare hammayim pesulin mippene shehi kishfoferet vehammayim nichnasin betochah veyotzin mittochah im hallecha shebbah:

Mayim mekuddashin sheshshata mehen behema o chayya pesulin. vechen kol haofot pesulin chutz min hayyona mippene shehi motzetzet veen rir yotze mippiha umitarev bammayim. vechen kol hashsheratzim sheshshatu enan poslin chutz min hachulda mippene shehi melakkeket bilshonah venimtzet hallecha yotza mippiha lammayim:
Me chattat shennishtannu marehen mechamat atzman kesherim. nishtannu mechamat ashan pesulin. higlidu vechazru venimmochu kesherim afillu nimmochu bachamma aval im himchan baur pesulin:
Efer chattat shennishtannu marav mechamat atzmo o mechamat ashan kasher. nishtannu mechamat avak o shennafal letocho sid o gafsis o shennitarev bo efer makle kol shehu hare ze pasul:
Hachoshev al me chattat lishtotan lo pesalan ad sheyyishte mehen. veim shafach min hakkeli letoch gerono velo naga sefato bammayim shebbakkeli lo pasal:

Keli sheyyesh bo mayim mekuddashin shehinnicho megulle uva umetzao mechusse hare ellu pesulin shemma adam sheeno tahor lechattat naga bahen shehare adam kissahu bevadday. hinnicho mechusse uva umetzao megulle im yechola hachulda lishtot mimmennu o sheyyarad lo tal ballayla pesulin veim lav kesherin mippene sheyyesh kan shete sefekot safek adam gilla o behema chayya varemes veim timtze lomar adam gillahu shemma haya tahor lechattat o lo:
Hammoser mayim mekuddashin o mayim shennitmalleu lekiddush letame leshamran hare ellu pesulin:

Shenayim shehayu shomrin et hammayim venitma echad mehen kesherim mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni. tahar vechazar lishmor venitma hashsheni kesherim mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon. nitmeu shenehen keachat hammayim pesulin:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 10:
Hamemale mayim lekiddush eno tzarich sheyyihye hu atzmo hamekaddesh vehammazze ella mekaddesh echad umazze echad. vechen memalle adam bichli umeare mikkeli lichli umekaddesh bichli acher umeare hammayim hamekuddashin mikkeli lichli umazze mikkeli acher: 
Memalle adam mayim umannichan etzlo belo kiddush kol zeman sheyyirtze veen bechach kelum. umolichan mimmakom lemakom umeir leir venoten alehen efer umekaddeshan bechol et sheyyirtze. vechen hammayim hamekuddashin mannichan adam etzlo yamim veshanim umazze mehen bechol yom shehu tzarich ad sheyyittammu umolichan mimmakom lemakom umeir leir. umeshammer adam efer para etzlo umolichah mimmakom lemakom umeir leir. paam achat holichu keli shehaya bo me chattat bisfina bayyarden venimtza kezayit min hammet bekarka hassefina venitmeu hammayim. beotah shaa gazru bet din haggadol sheen maavirin me chattat velo efer chattat benahar uvisfina velo yeshitem al pene hammayim. velo yaamod betzad hannahar mikkan veyizrekem latztzad hashsheni. aval over hu adam bemayim ad tzavvaro uveyado efer para o mayim mekuddashin. vechen adam vechelim harekanim shehen tehorin lechattat umayim shennitmalleu lechattat vaadayin lo nitkaddeshu maavirin otam benahar bisfina: 
Maavirin mayim mekuddashin bisfina bayyam haggadol veshatin [bahem] al pene hammayim. shello gazru ella al hammayim hamekuddashin veal haefer benahar: 
Hammolich mayim lekaddeshan veen tzarich lomar mayim shennitkaddeshu lo yafshil hakkeli laachorav ella lefanav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "lemishmeret leme nidda" bizman shehen shemurin hen me nidda veim lav pesulin. mille shete chaviyyot noten achat lefanav veachat laachorav mippene shei efshar: 
Me chattat sheshshekalan bemishkal im hissiach dato pesulin veim lav kesherin. aval im shakal devarim acherim beme chattat hoil vaasaan mishkolet pesalan sheen zo mishmeret. kol ellu hattehorim shemmemallein o shemmekaddeshin o shemmazzin vechen kol hakkelim shemmemallein umekaddeshin mehem veshemmazzin mehen im hayu tevule yom af al pi shello heeriv shimshan hare ellu kesherim. shekkol maase happara vehammilluy vehakkiddush vehahazzaya kasher bitvul yom kemo shebbearnu. umippene hatztzedokin metammein et kol kele shetef umatbilin otan veachar kach mishtammeshin bahen beme chattat: 
Hakkol kesherin lehazzot chutz meishsha vetumtum veanderoginus [vecheresh shote] vekatan sheen bo daat. aval katan sheyyesh bo daat kasher lehazzot vehearel kasher lehazzot sheen hearel tame. katan sheyyesh bo daat shehizza vehaishsha mesaaddato kegon sheachaza lo hammayim beyado hazzaato keshera uvilvad shello teechoz beyado bishat hazzaa. veim achaza beyado bishat hazzayato pesula: 
Hammazze tzarich lechavven ulehazzot al hattame letaharo veim hizza shello bechavvana hazzaato pesula. aval ze shemmazzin alav eno tzarich kavvana ella mazzin al haadam ledato veshello ledato. hammitkavven lehazzot lefanav vehizza laachorav laachorav vehizza lefanav hazzayato pesula. nitkavven lehazzot lefanav vehizza latztzedadin shel panav hazzayato keshera: 
Hammazze eno tzarich tevila lechol hazzaya ella tovel et haezov umazze hazzaya achar hazzaya ad sheyyiggamru hammayim. umazze hazzaya achat al kamma bene adam o al kamma kelim keachat afillu mea. kol shennaga bo min hammayim kol shehu tahor vehu sheyyitkavven hammazze lehazzot alav. taval et haezov venitkavven lehazzot al davar shemmekabbel tuma o al haadam vehizza meotah tevila al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma o al habbehema. im nisharu mayim baezov eno tzarich lachzor ulehatbil ella mazze min hashshear al haadam o al hakkelim hattemeim shehare techillat tevilato keshera hayta. aval im taval et haezov lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma o al habbehema vehizza al haadam o al hakkeli hattame hazzayato pesula ad sheyyachzor veyitbol paam sheniyya veyitkavven lehazzot al haadam o al davar hamekabbel tuma: 
Hitbil et haezov venitkavven lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma hammayim hamenattefim kesherin lefichach im natfu bichli vechazar vehitbil bahen et haezov bechavvana lehazzot al davar hamekabbel tuma hazzayato keshera: 
Me chattat shennitmaatu tovel bahen afillu rashe givolin umazze uvilvad shello yesappeg. tzelochit sheppiha tzar tovel umaale kedarko umazze veeno tzarich lehizzaher shemma yigga betzidde hakkeli befaam sheniyya:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 11:
Ketzad metaharim teme met beme nidda. lokeach adam tahor shelosha kelachin shel ezov veogdan aguda achat uvechol bad uvad givol echad vetovel rashe givolin beme nidda shebbakkeli umitkavven umazze al haadam o al hakkelim bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii achar shettanetz hachamma. veim hizza mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher. veachar sheyyazze alav bayyom hashshevii tovel bayyom umaariv shimsho vahare hu tahor laerev. taval et haezov ballayla vehizza bayyom o shettaval et haezov bayyom vehizza ballayla hazzaato pesula vehammayim metammein mishshum me chattat kemo sheyyitbaer. ad shettihye tevilat haezov bammayim vehazzaato mimmennu bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii achar shettanetz hachamma veim avar veasa mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shennitma bemet veshaha kamma yamim belo hazzaa kesheyyavo lehazzot mone befanenu shelosha yamim umazzin alav bashshelishi uvashshevii vetovel bashshevii umaariv shimsho. bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz shebba lehazzot sheafillu amar hayyom shelishi shelli eno neeman shemma hayyom nitma lefichach tzarich limnot befanenu. aval chaver shebba lehazzot mazzin alav o al kelav miyyad. mi shehuzza alav bashshelishi velo huzza alav bashshevii veshaha kamma yamim tovel bechol et sheyyirtze achar hashshevii ben bayyom ben ballayla umazzin alav bayyom ben kodem tevila ben achar tevila afillu taval belel teshii o belel asiri mazzin alav lemachar achar hanetz hachamma: 
Kol hametammein mekabbelin hazzaa. ketzad. zavim vezavot niddot veyoldot shennitmeu bemet mazzin alehen bashshelishi ushevii vahare hem tehorin mittumat met af al pi shehen temein tuma acheret. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 19)</small> "vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi" ha lamadta shehazzaya moelet lo af al pi shehu tame. vechen hearel mekabbel hazzaa. ketzad. arel shennitma bemet vehizza alav shelishi ushevii hare ze tahor mittumat met. uchesheyyamul tovel veochel bekadashim laerev: 
Mitzvat ezov shelosha kelachin vechol kelach vekelach givol echad. nimtzeu shelosha givolin. usheyarav shenayim. o im lakach shenayim battechilla vaagadan kasher. nitpardu haggivolin venashru healin afillu lo nishar mikkol givol mehem ella kol shehu kasher sheshsheyare haezov bechol shehu. kelach sheyyesh bo shelosha baddin mefasseko veachar kach oged shelashtan shemmitzvato lihyot agudda af al pi shello nitparesh battora sheyyihye agudda. pesako velo agado o sheagado velo pesako o shello pesako velo agado vehizza bo kasher. haezov hakkatzar ogdo bechut al hakkush vechayyotze bo vetovel bemayim umaale veochez baezov umazze. nistappek lo im min hachut hizza o min hakkush o min haggivol hazzaato pesula: 
En mazzin lo beyonkot haezov velo battemarot ella baggivolin. ellu hen hayyonkot givolin shello gamlu. umi shehuzza alav beyonkot venichnas lammikdash patur. umeematay mazzin baezov mishsheyyanetz. veezov shehuzza bo me nidda kasher letaher bo et hametzora. kol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levavy pasul. vehaezov shekkorin oto ezov beyichud hu hakkasher vehu haezov sheochlin oto baale battim. aval ze shekkorin oto ezov yon veezov kachlit veezov midbari pasul: 
Ezov shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat veshel avoda zara veshel teruma temea pesula. shel teruma tehora lo yazze veim hizza kasher: 
Ezov shellikketo leetzim venaflu alav mashkin menaggevo vehu kasher lehazzaya. likketo loochalin venaflu alav mashkin af al pi shenniggevo pasul shehare nitma lehazzaya shekkol hammashkin vechol hoochalin vechol hakkelim hare hen kitmeim leinyan chattat kemo shebbearnu. likketo lechattat hare ze kenilkat leetzim veim naflu alav mashkin menaggevo umazze bo:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 12:
Adam shennitma bemet vehizza alav kevan shennaga kol shehu mimme hannidda bechol makom meor besaro shel tame alta lo hazzaya. afillu nafla hahazzaa al rosh etzbao o al rosh sefato. aval im naga bilshono enah kelum. af al pi shehallashon keevarim shebbegaluy leinyan tuma kemo shebbearnu. enan keevarim shebbegaluy leinyan hazzaa utevila. vechen keli shennitma bemet vehizza alav kevan shehiggia legufo shel keli kol shehu mimme hannidda alta lo hazzaa: 
Shene kelim o shene bene adam shennitkavven lehazzot al shenehen keachat vehizza al echad mehen. venatfu hammayim meal harishon al hashsheni hare hashsheni betumato ad sheyyippelu alav hammayim mehazzayat hammazze lo min hattamtzit. hizza al shene kelim venistappek lo im hizza al shenehen keachad o mechavero nimtza alav hazzayato pesula: 
Machat shennetuna al hacheres vehizza aleha safek al hammachat hizza safek min hacheres nimtza aleha hazzayato pesula: 
Kelim hamefutztzalin shemmechubbarin ze laze bemasmerim. kegon misporet shel perakim veizmel shel rehitni vechayyotze bahen. bishat melacha chibbur letuma ulehazzaya. shello bishat melacha eno chibbur lo laze velo laze. ketzad hen chibbur letuma ulehazzaya. sheim nitma echad mehen bishat melacha nitma hashsheni. veim hizza al echad mehen bishat melacha alta hazzaya lishnehen ucheillu hen guf echad. vechetzad eno chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaya. sheim nitma echad mehen shello bishat melacha lo nitma chavero. veim nitmeu shenehen vehizza al echad mehen shello bishat melacha lo tiher chavero af al pi shehen mechubbarin. vezehu din tora. aval middivre sofrim gazru sheyyihyu chibbur letuma afillu shello bishat melacha gezera mishshum sheat melacha. uleolam im naga beechad mehen tuma nitma chavero. vechen gazru alehen shello yihyu chibbur lehazzaya afillu bishat melacha gezera mishshum shello bishat melacha. uleolam im hizza al echad mehen lo tiher chavero ad sheyyazze gam alav. hinne lamadta shekkol makom shaatta shomea chibbur letuma veeno chibbur lehazzaya en ze ella gezera middivrehem al hadderech shebbearnu: 
Shene kelim shechibberan ad shennaasu keguf echad. kegon shettafar shene begadim o shete yeriot hare ellu chibbur letuma ulehazzaa mippene shehen kichli echad: 
Shelal hakkovsin vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim vehen omdin lehattiran eno chibbur lehazzaya vahare hen chibbur letuma. vechen hasselaim shebbakkantal. vehammitta shel tarbal. vekeren shel keliva. vekarnayim shel yotze derachim. veshalshelet hammaftechot. chibbur letuma velo lehazzaa. ella tzarich sheyyiggeu hammayim min hammazze bechol sal vesal. uvechol mafteach umafteach. uvechol keren vekeren. uvechol kora vekora mimmitta zo hamefutztzelet: 
Hamechabber shalosh kesatot shel tzemer veshesh shel pishtan. o shelosha sedinim o shetem esre mitpachot. hare ellu chibbur letuma ulehazzaa. yeter mikkan chibbur letuma velo lehazzaa. chaluk echad vetallit achat ukeluvekarin echad hare hen chibbur letuma ulehazzaya afillu hayu arukkin beyoter o rechavin beyoter kol shehen. vee zehu keluvekarin ze shene begadim shemmannichin tzemer gefen benehen vetofrin otan keachat veosin mehen chaluk limot haggeshamim: 
Kissuy hammecham shemmechubbar beshalshelet. hizza al hammecham tiher hakkol. hizza al hakkissuy lo tiher hammecham ad sheyyazze alav: 
Hazzog vehainbal chibbur letuma ulehazzaa veim hizza al echad mehen tiharu shenehen: 
Hattevivy shettovim bo happishtim o shozrin bo hachavalim shelosha gufin yesh bo. haetz shemmelappefin alav hattavuyi vehu hannikra kush. vehannechoshet o habbarzel shebberosh haetz vehu hannikra tzinnora shebbah potlin vetovin. veharechayim shebbeemtza hakkush vehi hannikret pika. hakkush sheppotlin bo hachavalim shennitma lo yazze al happika shello velo al hakkush ella al hatztzinnora. veim hizza al echad mishshelashtan tiher hakkol. veshel pishtan mazze al echad mishshelashtan lechattechilla sheshshelashtan chibbur: 
Or shel arisa shehu mechubbar lefikot. chibbur letuma ulehazzaa. hammalben shel mittot eno chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaa: 
Kol yedot hakkelim hakkeduchot kegon nitztzav hassakkin vechayyotze bo shehannitztzav nakuv vehabbarzel nichnas bo chibbur letuma ulehazzaa. aval hayyadot hacharukot kegon etz hachanit shehaetz nichnas babbarzel eno chibbur lehazzaa:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 13:
Maalot yeterot asu betohorat hachattat. shehaadam hattahor afillu taval lekodesh veomed umeshammesh al gabbe hammizbeach eno tahor lechattat velo lisrefat happara velo lemilluy hammayim velo lekaddeshan velo lehazzot ad sheyyitbol leshem chattat veachar kach yihye tahor lechattat. vechen hakkelim afillu mizrak shebbaazara eno tahor lechattat ad sheyyatbiluhu leshem chattat. vechen kol hoochalin vechol hammashkin af al pi shehen tehorin hare hen leinyan chattat koochalin umashkin hametammein: 
Kol keli harauy lemishkav o lemoshav af al pi shehu tahor legabbe hakkodesh hare hu legabbe chattat kemidras hazzav ad sheyyatbiluhu leshem chattat. yochanan ben gudgeda haya ochel betohorat hakkodesh kol yamav vehaya mitpachto kemidras hazzav leinyan hachattat: 
Kol velad hattumot af al pi sheeno metamme adam velo chelim afillu lekodesh kemo shebbearnu. hare hu metamme adam vechelim lechattat. lefichach amru hamekaddesh et me chattat lo yinol et hassandal. shemma yippelu mashkin al hassandal venimtza hassandal tame shekkol hammashkin temein hen ligobbe hchottat vititomme ze hamekaddesh bingiato besandal venimtzeu me chattat temeim: 
Mi shennitmeu yadav bilvad baddevarim hametammein et hayyadayim kegon shennaga boochalin o bemashkin vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehu tahor lakkodesh veeno tzarich ella tevilat yadav bilvad kemo sheyyitbaer. hare nitma kol gufo leinyan hachattat vetzarich tevila. afillu lo nitmet ella yado achat nitma kullo vahare hu rishon letuma: 
Kol hattaun tevila ben min hattora ben middivrehem metamme et me chattat veet efer hachattat veet hammazze me chattat bemagga uvemassa. vechen metamme et haezov hammuchshar veet hammayim shennitmalleu vaadayin lo nitkaddeshu. veet hakkeli harekan hattahor lechattat. metamme kol echad meellu bemagga aval lo bemassa. vetame shennaga bemiktzat efer chattat pasal et kullo: 
En monin lechattat rishon vesheni ushelishi kederech shemmonin litruma ulekodesh. ketzad. asara shettavlu leshem chattat venitma echad mehen afillu lo nitma ella legabbe chattat bilvad kegon shennitmet yado bilvad venaga bachavero vachavero bachavero afillu hen mea kullan temein lechattat. vechen chelim hattehorim lechattat shennitma keli mehen afillu lo nitmeu ella achorav bilvad legabbe chattat kegon shennagu mashkin baachorav venaga keli ze bichli sheni vesheni bishlishi nitmeu hakkelim kullan legabbe hachattat vaafillu hen mea: 
Kol harauy lehittamme bemidras hazzav af al pi shehu tahor lekodesh im henido hattahor lechattat nitma af al pi shello naga bo. vechen hattahor lechattat shehenid et haadam sheeno tahor lechattat. o shehenid et rukko o et meme raglav shel adam ze. nitma af al pi shello naga bo. aval keli sheeno rauy lemidras eno metamme et hattahor lechattat ella im ken naga bo: 
Keli hattame bitme met im henido hattahor lechattat nitma veaf al pi shello naga bo veaf al pi sheen teme met metamme bemassa kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. mafteach shehu teme met shehaya taluy baddelet vesagar hattahor lechattat et haddelet hoil vehenid et hammafteach hattame nitma. vechen im hesit et hashsheretz veet shichvat zera hare ze tame lechattat af al pi sheen ellu metammein bemassa kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hattahor lechattat shennaga bechelim shehayu lemala min hazzav vechayyotze bo vehen hannikrain maddaf af al pi shehu tahor lekodesh nitma lechattat. vechen keli hattahor lechattat shennaga bemaddaf nitma lechattat: 
Hattahor lechattat shennaga boochalin umashkin ben tehorin ben temeim shekkol ochalin umashkin legabbe chattat enan tehorin im naga bahen beyado nitma kol gufo kemo shebbearnu. naga bahen beraglo o bishar gufo o shehesitan beyado velo naga bahen tahor. vechen im naga betannur vechayyotze bo mishar kelim sheenam tehorin lechattat nitma kullo. aval im naga beraglo bahen hare hu tahor lechattat kemo shehaya: 
Hattahor lechattat shehichnis rosho verubbo letoch mayim shennitmalleu lechattat nitma mippene shehen sheuvin. umiddivre sofrim shehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin nitma kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hakkol neemanin al tohorat hachattat vaafillu amme haaretz mippene chumratah. umaalot ellu sheasu bah hakkol nizharin bah. vahare neemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret" kol yisrael reuyin lishmira. lefichach am haaretz shehevi keli mibbeto afillu keli cheres veamar keli ze tahor lechattat hare ze tahor umekaddeshin bo umazzin mimmennu. veaf al pi sheoto keli tame lekodesh velitruma. vechen am haaretz sheamar tahor ani lechattat o shehayu me chattat etzlo veamar tehorin hen neeman. sheen adam miyyisrael mezalzel bah:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 14:
Keli cheres shehaya bo efor chattat venaga bo sheretz mitztziddo tahor sheen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo afillu legabbe chattat. hinniach hakkeli al gabbe hashsheretz af al pi shello nitma hakkeli hare haefer tame shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "vehinniach michutz lammachane bemakom tahor" veen ze makom tahor. velo al gabbe hashsheretz bilvad ella afillu hinnicho al gabbe ochel sheni vechayyotze bo middevarim shettumatan tuma kalla vehem middivre sofrim hare nitma haefer shenneemar bemakom tahor shello yihye al [gabbe] shum tuma baolam. vechen keli cheres shehaya bo efer chattat venatun al arubba shebbabbayit tame. im haya hakkeli meshulshal labbayit nitma haefer veaf al pi sheen baarubba poteach tefach. veim lo haya meshulshal im haya baarubba poteach tefach tame: 
Haya hakkeli shel even. ben sheyyesh bah poteach tefach ben sheen bah haefer tahor: 
Vechen keli sheyyesh bo efer o mayim mekuddashim umukkaf tzamid patil venatun beohel hammet. hare haefer vehammayim temeim sheen efer hachattat nitztzelet betzamid patil shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "bemakom tahor" veen ze makom tahor: 
Vechen ochalin umashkin shel kodesh enan nitztzalin betzamid patil. aval mayim sheenan mekuddashin ucheli rekan hattahor lechattat nitztzal betzamid patil. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu habbealim tehorim. aval im nitmeu habbealim nifselu hammayim bechol makom shehen. ketzad. hayu memav mukkafin tzamid patil vehu vehem beohel hammet shenehen temeim. haya hu mibbachutz vehammayim sheenan mekuddashin mibbifnim shenehen tehorin. hu bifnim vehammayim bachutz keshem shehu tame kach memav pesulin: 
Hattahor lechattat shehaya omed al gabbe hattannur vechayyotze bo mikkelim sheenam tehorim lechattat ufashat yado chutz lattannur ucheli sheyyesh bo me chattat beyado. vechen kane hammuttal al gabbe hattannur ushene kelim sheyyesh bahen me chattat teluyin bo echad mikkan veachad mikkan hare ellu temein lefi sheenan bemakom hattahor lechattat. vehoil vehem nishanin al hattannur hare hen keillu munnachin al gabbav. aval im haya omed al hattannur uveyado keli rekan hattahor lechattat o mayim sheenan mekuddashin hare ellu tehorin kemot shehayu. haya omed chutz lattannur ufashat yado lachallon venatal keli sheyyesh bo chattat veheeviro al gabbe hattannur hare ze tahor. vechen hazzaya sheavra al gabbe tuma kegon mishkav umoshav vechayyotze bahen hare zo tehora: 
Keli sheyyesh bo me chattat ucheli sheyyesh bo kodesh shennagu ze baze hare nitma keli shel chattat vechol sheyyesh bo aval keli hakkodesh tahor keshehaya. vechen im naga hattahor lachattat bishnehen bishte yadav keshehen munnachin al haaretz hare nitma shel chattat shehare hattahor lechattat nitma bingiat hakkeli sheeno tahor lechattat kemo shebbearnu vechazar vetimme et me chattat: 
Higbiah shene hakkelim bishte yadav shenehen temein ze shel chattat nitma mippene shennaga bo adam shennaga bichli sheeno tahor lechattat veshel kodesh nitma mippene ze shehigbiho vehu tame binsiat me nidda shehen metammein bemassa mippene shennitmeu mechamat hakkeli shel kodesh. lefichach im haya hakkeli shel kodesh karuch binyar vehigbiah banneyar velo naga bo vehigbiah hachattat beyado sheniyya shenehen tehorin shehare lo naga bakkeli velo nitma lechattat. aval im haya nogea bichli hakkodesh beyado afillu haya shel chattat binyar shenehem temein: 
Hesit et shene hakkelim beyado velo naga bahen shenehen tehorin sheen hakkeli sheeno tahor lechattat metamme et hattahor lechattat ad sheyyaga bo beyado ella im ken haya rauy lemidras kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol sefek hattumot shehu tahor legabbe teruma kemo sheyyitbaer hare hu tahor lechattat. vechol hassefekot shettolin bahen et hatteruma im noldu bechattat hare ellu nishpachin. veim naasu tohorot al gabbe otan kelim veadam shennoldu lahen sefekot ellu shehachattaot nishpachin alehen hare otan hattohorot teluyot. veharfafot enan kechelim vahare hen tehorot litruma ulekodesh ulechattat: 
Devela shel teruma shennafla letoch me chattat unetalah vaachalah im yesh bah kevetza hammayim temein. ben shehayta haddevela temea ben shehayta tehora. shekkol hoochalin afillu ochel kodesh eno tahor lechattat. vehaochlah chayyav mita mippene sheachal teruma temea. veim en bah kevetza hammayim betohoratan. sheen haochel metamme acherim ad sheyyihye bo kevetza ben litruma ben lekodesh ben lechattat:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 15:
Hannogea beme chattat shello letzorech hazzaa ben adam ben kelim tame veeno metamme begadim bishat maggao. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 21)</small> "vehannogea beme hannidda yitma ad haarev". hinne lamadta shemme hannidda av meavot hattumot shel tora. vetumat maggaan bechol shehu. veim haya bahen kede hazzaa metammein bemagga uvemassa. vehannogea bahen o shennosan shello letzorech metamme begadim bishat maggao o bishat massao ad sheyyifrosh mimmetammeav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 21)</small> "umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav". eno medabber bemazze al hattame im tiher et hattame kal vachomer sheyyihye hu tahor. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora umazze me hannidda lo neemar ella leshiur shehannogea o hannose me nidda sheyyesh bahen kede hazzaya shello letzorech hazzaa tame umetamme begadim din tora. vechamma hu shiur hazzaa kede sheyyitbol rashe givolin shel ezov bemayim. bamme devarim amurim shemme chattat metammein bizman shennaga bahen o nesaan shello letzorech kodem sheyyaasu mitzvatan. aval achar sheasu mitzvatan enan metammein kelal. ketzad. hare shettaval et haezov vehizza al haadam hattame o al hakkelim vehayu hammayim shottin veyordin meal hattame laaretz. vechen hammayim hannittazin bishat hazzaa al haaretz o al hattahor hare otan hammayim tehorim vehannogea bahen vehannosan tahor. hitbil et haezov lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma hare hammayim hamenattefin kesherin lehazzot mehen kemo shebbearnu. lefichach metammein tumat me chattat lefi shello asu mitzvatan shehare hattevila hayta leshem davar sheeno mekabbel tuma: 
En me chattat metammein et hakkol kodem sheyyaasu mitzvatan ad sheyyihyu tehorin uchesherin lehazzaa. aval me chattat shennifselu kegon shennitarev bahen mayim o sheshshatta mehen behema vechayyotze bahen meellu haddevarim happoslin otan im naga bahen hattahor litruma nitma ben shennaga beyadav ben shennaga bishar gufo. naga bahen adam hattahor lechattat vaafillu beyadav hare hu tahor kemot shehayu: 
Me chattat shennitmeu venaga bahen achar shennitmeu adam hattahor litruma ben beyadav ben begufo nitma. veim naga bahen hattahor lechattat beyadav nitma. naga bishar gufo hare hu tahor kemot shehaya: 
Me chattat shennaflu letochan me mayan o me mikve o me perot. im rov me chattat metammein bemassa. veim rov me perot en metammein. mechetza lemechetza metammein. efer para shennitarev beefer makle vekiddesh bechullan im haya harov efer para metammein beme nidda. veim haya harov efer makle en metammein bemagga aval metammein bemassa: 
Efer kasher shennetano al gabbe hammayim sheenan reuyin lekaddeshan venaga bahen hattahor litruma ben beyadav ben begufo nitma. naga bahen hattahor lechattat afillu beyadav hare ze tahor kemot shehaya: 
Me chattat shennifselu lo yegabbelem betit shello yaasem takkala laacherim shemma yigga battit vitamme. shemme chattat enam betelin betit shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "chattat hi": 
Para sheshshatat me chattat af al pi shennishchata betoch 24 shaot besarah tahor shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "lemishmeret leme nidda". bizman shehen shemurin enan betelin. aval bizman sheshshetaatan para batlu shehare enam shemurin: 
Hammazze mechallon shemmazzin mimmennu al harabbim. vehuzza alav venichnas lammikdash veachar kach nimtzeu hammayim pesulin hare ze patur. shechezkat hammayim shemmazzin mehen al harabbim shehen kesherin vahare ze keanus. aval im huzza alav mechallon shel yachid venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulin chayyav bekarban ole veyored mippene shehaya lo livdok al hammayim veachar kach yikkanes lammikdash. machalikim hayu haam bammayim sheshshottim baaretz mechallon shel rabbim vedorsim otan venichnasim lammikdash velo hayu choshshin lahen shemma pesulin hen: 
Hammazze beezov hattame lechattat. im yesh bo kevetza hammayim pesulin vehazzayato [pesula]. en bo kevetza hammayim kesherim vehazzaato pesula. veezov ze metamme chavero vachavero lachavero afillu hen mea sheen monin lechattat: 
Hammagbiah keli shehuzza alav vahare alav hammayim kede hazzaa tahor shehammayim sheasu mitzvatan enan metammein kemo shebbearnu: berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 1: Kol mitzvot shebbattora ben ase ben lo taase im avar adam al achat mehen ben bezadon ben bishgaga kesheyyaase teshuva veyashuv mecheto chayyav lehitvaddot lifne hael baruch hu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 6)</small> "ish o ishsha ki yaasu" vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 5 7)</small> "vehitvaddu et chattatam asher asu" ze vidduy devarim. vidduy ze mitzvat ase. ketzad mitvaddin. omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha veasiti kach vechach vahare nichamti uvoshti bemaasay uleolam eni chozer ledavar ze. vezehu ikkaro shel vidduy. vechol hammarbe lehitvaddot umaarich beinyan ze hare ze meshubbach. vechen baale chattaot vaashamot beet shemmeviin karbenotehen al shiggatan o al zedonan en mitkapper lahen bekarbanam ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu vidduy devarim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 5)</small> "vehitvadda asher chata aleha". vechen kol mechuyyeve mitot bet din umechuyyeve malkot en mitkapper lahen bemitatan o bilkiyyatan ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu. vechen hachovel bachavero vehammazzik mamono af al pi sheshshillem lo ma shehu chayyav lo eno mitkapper ad sheyyitvadde veyashuv millaasot kaze leolam shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 6)</small> "mikkol chattot haadam":
